items.translation: 设置用于标识 SQL 脚本中单行注释的前缀。

items.source: Set the prefixes that identify single-line comments within the SQL scripts.
items.translation: 设置用于标识 SQL 脚本中单行注释的前缀。

items.source:
Specify concurrency limits via a "lower-upper" String, for example, "5-10", or a simple
upper limit String, for example, "10".
items.translation: 通过“下界 - 上界”形式的字符串指定并发限制，例如"5-10"，或通过简单的上界字符串指定，例如"10"。

items.source: Set the underlying connect timeout in milliseconds.
items.translation: 设置底层连接超时时间（毫秒）。

items.source:
Configure the supported content codings from the
"Accept-Encoding" header for which to cache resource variations.
items.translation: 从 "Accept-Encoding" 响应头配置用于缓存资源变体的支持内容编码。

items.source: Configure the supported content codings in order of preference.
items.translation: 配置支持的内容编码的优先级顺序。

items.source: Flag to indicate that all failures in SQL should be logged but not cause a failure.
items.translation: 标记指示应记录所有 SQL 失败但不导致失败。

items.source: Set the ThreadPoolExecutor's core pool size.
items.translation: 设置 ThreadPoolExecutor 的核心池大小。

items.source: Set user credentials for this proxy and the current thread.
items.translation: 为此代理和当前线程设置用户凭据。

items.source: Expose an isolation level for the current transaction.
items.translation: 暴露当前事务的隔离级别。

items.source: Expose the name of the current transaction, if any.
items.translation: 如果存在当前事务，则暴露其名称。

items.source: Expose a read-only flag for the current transaction.
items.translation: 为当前事务暴露一个只读标志。

items.source: Set the JDBC DataSource that this instance should manage transactions for.
items.translation: 设置该实例应为其管理事务的 JDBC DataSource。

items.source:
Specify the JDBC DataSource that the JPA persistence provider is supposed
to use for accessing the database.
items.translation: 指定 JPA 持久化提供者用于访问数据库的 JDBC DataSource。

items.source:
Set the given date under the given header name after formatting it as a string
using the RFC-1123 date-time formatter.
items.translation: 使用 RFC-1123 日期时间格式化器将给定日期格式化为字符串后，将其设置在给定的标头名称下。

items.source:
Specify the default domain to be used for generating ObjectNames
when no source-level metadata has been specified.
items.translation: 指定在尚未指定源代码级别元数据时，用于生成 ObjectNames 的默认域。

items.source: Set the delay between refresh checks, in milliseconds.
items.translation: 设置刷新检查之间的延迟（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source: Set the delivery mode to use when sending a message.
items.translation: 设置发送消息时使用的投递模式。

items.source: Set the names of the beans that this bean depends on being initialized.
items.translation: 设置此 Bean 所依赖的 Bean 初始化名称。

items.source:
When this property is configured only messages to destinations matching
one of the configured prefixes are eligible for handling.
items.translation: 配置此属性后，只有匹配已配置前缀之一的消息才有资格进行处理。

items.source: Disables caching of the generated JSON.
items.translation: 禁用生成的 JSON 的缓存。

items.source:
Set the encoding used to decode byte sequences to character sequences when
reading the FreeMarker template file for this view.
items.translation: 设置用于在读取此视图的 FreeMarker 模板文件时将字节序列解码为字符序列的编码。

items.source:
Specify the encoding to use when converting to and from text-based
message body content.
items.translation: 指定用于将文本消息正文内容转换为和从该格式转换的编码。

items.source:
Specify the name of the JMS message property that carries the encoding from
bytes to String and back is BytesMessage is used during the conversion process.
items.translation: 指定在转换过程中使用 BytesMessage 时，承载从字节到字符串及反向编码的 JMS 消息属性名称。

items.source:
Set a Hibernate entity interceptor that allows to inspect and change
property values before writing to and reading from the database.
items.translation: 设置一个 Hibernate 实体拦截器，以便在写入和读取数据库之前检查和修改属性值。

items.source:
Set whether to make all Spring beans in the application context accessible
as request attributes, through lazy checking once an attribute gets accessed.
items.translation: 设置是否通过懒加载检查（仅在访问属性时进行）使应用程序上下文中的所有 Spring bean 可用作请求属性。

items.source: Specify the names of beans in the context which are supposed to be exposed.
items.translation: 指定上下文中需要暴露的 bean 名称。

items.source:
Set whether all request attributes should be added to the
model prior to merging with the template.
items.translation: 设置是否应在与模板合并之前将所有请求属性添加到模型中。

items.source:
Set whether all HttpSession attributes should be added to the
model prior to merging with the template.
items.translation: 设置是否应在与模板合并之前，将所有 HttpSession 属性添加到模型中。

items.source:
Set whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library,
under the name "springMacroRequestContext".
items.translation: 设置是否暴露一个 RequestContext 供 Spring 的宏库使用，名称为"springMacroRequestContext"。

items.source:
Specify whether this FactoryBean should expose an unconfigurable
decorator for the created executor.
items.translation: 指定此 FactoryBean 是否应为创建的 Executor 暴露一个不可配置的装饰器。

items.source: Configure mappings from content codings to file extensions.
items.translation: 配置从内容编码到文件扩展名的映射。

items.source:
Set whether to serialize models containing a single attribute as a map or
whether to extract the single value from the model and serialize it directly.
items.translation: 设置是将包含单个属性的模型序列化为 Map，还是从模型中提取单个值并直接序列化它。

items.source: Specify the factory bean to use, if any.
items.translation: 指定要使用的工厂 Bean（如有）。

items.source: Specify a factory method, if any.
items.translation: 指定工厂方法（如有）。

items.source: Set whether this bean is a fallback autowire candidate.
items.translation: 设置该 Bean 是否为回退自动装配候选者。

items.source: Set the Predicate that filters the header names to use for data binding.
items.translation: 设置用于数据绑定的标题名称的谓词。

items.source: Set the character set used to decode headers.
items.translation: 设置用于解码标头的字符集。

items.source: Configure one or more hosts associated with the application.
items.translation: 配置与应用程序关联的一个或多个主机。

items.source: Set the mappings of bean keys to a comma-separated list of method names.
items.translation: 将 Bean 键的映射设置为方法名的逗号分隔列表。

items.source:
Set whether the XSLT transformer may add additional whitespace when
outputting the result tree.
items.translation: 设置 XSLT 转换器在输出结果树时是否可以添加额外的空白。

items.source: Register objects in the JobDataMap via a given Map.
items.translation: 通过给定的 Map 在 JobDataMap 中注册对象。

items.source: Set the ThreadPoolExecutor's keep-alive seconds.
items.translation: 设置 ThreadPoolExecutor 的存活时间（秒）。

items.source: Set whether this bean should be lazily initialized.
items.translation: 设置该 Bean 是否应延迟初始化。

items.source: Set whether to lazily initialize handlers.
items.translation: 设置是否延迟初始化处理器。

items.source: Specify whether parsing is to be lenient.
items.translation: 指定解析是否采用宽松模式。

items.source:
Associate the given Locale with the current thread,
preserving any TimeZone that may have been set already.
items.translation: 将给定的 Locale 与当前线程关联，同时保留可能已设置的任何 TimeZone。

items.source: Set the name of the logger to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的日志记录器名称。

items.source: Set the login header.
items.translation: 设置登录标题。

items.source: Set whether to look up the JNDI object on startup.
items.translation: 设置是否在启动时查找 JNDI 对象。

items.source: Map URL paths to handler bean names.
items.translation: 将 URL 路径映射到处理器 Bean 名称。

items.source: Configure the maximum amount of memory that is allowed per headers section of each part.
items.translation: 配置每个部分每个头部区域允许的最大内存量。

items.source:
Configure a limit on the number of bytes that can be buffered whenever
the input stream needs to be aggregated.
items.translation: 配置输入流需要聚合时，可缓冲的字节数限制。

items.source: The max size allowed per message.
items.translation: 每条消息允许的最大大小。

items.source: Specify the maximum number of parts allowed in a given multipart request.
items.translation: 指定给定多部分请求中允许的最大部分数。

items.source: Set the ThreadPoolExecutor's maximum pool size.
items.translation: 设置 ThreadPoolExecutor 的最大池大小。

items.source: Set the strategy to use for resolving errors into message codes.
items.translation: 设置用于将错误解析为消息代码的策略。

items.source: Set the attributes in the model that should be rendered by this view.
items.translation: 设置应由该视图渲染的模型属性。

items.source:
Set whether to optimize the specified locations through an existence
check on startup, filtering non-existing directories upfront so that
they do not have to be checked on every resource access.
items.translation: 设置是否在启动时通过存在性检查优化指定位置，预先过滤不存在的目录，以便在每次资源访问时无需进行检查。

items.source: Set the order for this result handler relative to others.
items.translation: 设置此结果处理器相对于其他处理器的顺序。

items.source: Specify the order value for this HandlerMapping bean.
items.translation: 为此 HandlerMapping Bean 指定顺序值。

items.source: Specify the order value for this ViewResolver bean.
items.translation: 为此 ViewResolver Bean 指定顺序值。

items.source: Specify the order value for this HandlerAdapter bean.
items.translation: 为此 HandlerAdapter Bean 指定顺序值。

items.source: Set arbitrary transformer output properties to be applied to the stylesheet.
items.translation: 设置任意转换器的输出属性，这些属性将应用于样式表。

items.source: Set the value for a parameter.
items.translation: 设置参数的值。

items.source: Set the path that this tag should apply.
items.translation: 设置此标签应应用的路径。

items.source: Configure path prefixes to apply to controller methods.
items.translation: 配置应用于控制器方法的路径前缀。

items.source: Specify the pattern to use to format number values.
items.translation: 指定用于格式化数值模式的模式。

items.source: Set the regular expressions defining methods to match.
items.translation: 设置定义方法的正则表达式以匹配。

items.source: Set the name of the persistence unit to access the EntityManagerFactory for.
items.translation: 设置持久化单元的名称，用于访问 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source: Specify the lifecycle phase for pausing and resuming this executor.
items.translation: 指定暂停和恢复此执行器的生命周期阶段。

items.source: Set the ScheduledExecutorService's pool size.
items.translation: 设置 ScheduledExecutorService 的池大小。

items.source: Indicate whether the JSON output by this view should be prefixed with ")]}', ".
items.translation: 指示此视图输出的 JSON 是否应以 ")]}', " 作为前缀。

items.source:
Set whether to prepare the underlying JDBC Connection of a transactional
Hibernate Session, that is, whether to apply a transaction-specific
isolation level and/or the transaction's read-only flag to the underlying
JDBC Connection.
items.translation: 设置是否准备事务性 Hibernate Session 的底层 JDBC 连接，即是否将特定于事务的隔离级别和/或事务的只读标志应用于底层 JDBC 连接。

items.source: Specify whether to start all core threads, causing them to idly wait for work.
items.translation: 指定是否启动所有核心线程，使它们空闲等待工作。

items.source: Set whether this bean is a primary autowire candidate.
items.translation: 设置该 Bean 是否为主要的自动装配候选者。

items.source: Indicate whether external XML entities are processed when converting to a Source.
items.translation: 指示在转换为 Source 时是否处理外部 XML 实体。

items.source: Indicate whether external XML entities are processed when unmarshalling.
items.translation: 指示在反序列化时是否处理外部 XML 实体。

items.source: Set the PropertiesPersister to use for parsing properties files.
items.translation: 设置用于解析属性文件的 PropertiesPersister。

items.source: Set the ClassLoader to generate the proxy class in.
items.translation: 将 ClassLoader 设置为生成代理类的类加载器。

items.source: Set whether to inhibit the delivery of messages published by its own connection.
items.translation: 设置是否抑制由其自身连接发布消息的投递。

items.source: Set the capacity for the ThreadPoolExecutor's BlockingQueue.
items.translation: 设置 ThreadPoolExecutor 的 BlockingQueue 容量。

items.source: Configure the registry for adapting various reactive types.
items.translation: 配置注册表以适配各种响应式类型。

items.source: Set the underlying URLConnection's read timeout (in milliseconds).
items.translation: 设置底层 URLConnection 的读取超时时间（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source: Set the name of the header used to determine the send timeout (if present).
items.translation: 设置用于确定发送超时（如果存在）的标头名称。

items.source: Set the render function name (optional).
items.translation: 设置渲染函数名称（可选）。

items.source: Set the object where the render function belongs (optional).
items.translation: 设置渲染函数所属的对象（可选）。

items.source: Set the resource loader path(s) via a Spring resource location.
items.translation: 通过 Spring 资源位置设置资源加载器路径。

items.source: Set the scope to export the variable to.
items.translation: 将作用域设置为导出变量的范围。

items.source: Set the scripts to be loaded by the script engine (library or user provided).
items.translation: 设置由脚本引擎（库或用户提供的）加载的脚本。

items.source:
Configure the name of a header that a subscription message can have for
the purpose of filtering messages matched to the subscription.
items.translation: 配置订阅消息可以拥有的用于过滤匹配到该订阅的消息的标题名称。

items.source: Specify the statement separator, if a custom one.
items.translation: 如果指定了自定义的语句分隔符，请指定它。

items.source:
Set if a singleton should be created, or a new object on each request
otherwise.
items.translation: 设置是否应创建单例，或在其他情况下为每个请求创建新对象。

items.source: Set the name of the model attribute that represents the XSLT Source.
items.translation: 设置代表 XSLT 源（Source）的模型属性名称。

items.source:
Specify the encoding for the configured SQL scripts,
if different from the platform encoding.
items.translation: 如果配置的 SQL 脚本的编码与平台编码不同，请指定其编码。

items.source: Set the start delay in milliseconds.
items.translation: 设置以毫秒为单位的启动延迟。

items.source: Set a specific start time for the trigger.
items.translation: 为触发器设置特定的开始时间。

items.source:
Configure "streaming" media types for which flushing should be performed
automatically vs at the end of the stream.
items.translation: 配置应在何时自动刷新流媒体类型：是在流结束时，还是立即执行。

items.source:
Specify whether to initiate an early shutdown signal on context close,
disposing all idle threads and rejecting further task submissions.
items.translation: 指定是否在上下文关闭时启动提前关闭信号，从而终止所有空闲线程并拒绝进一步的任务提交。

items.source: Set the two characters to use to format date values.
items.translation: 设置用于格式化日期值的两个字符。

items.source: Set the class which the generated class will extend.
items.translation: 设置生成的类将继承的类。

items.source:
Set if controller execution should be synchronized on the session,
to serialize parallel invocations from the same client.
items.translation: 设置是否应在会话上同步控制器执行，以序列化来自同一客户端的并行调用。

items.source:
Set the path in the system preferences tree to use for resolving
placeholders.
items.translation: 在系统偏好设置树中设置用于解析占位符的路径。

items.source: Set the name of the target bean.
items.translation: 设置目标 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Set the target ConnectionFactory that this ConnectionFactory should delegate to.
items.translation: 设置此 ConnectionFactory 应委托的目标 ConnectionFactory。

items.source:
Set the given text directly as content in non-multipart mode
or as default body part in multipart mode.
items.translation: 在非多部分模式下将给定文本直接设置为内容，或在多部分模式下将其设置为默认正文部分。

items.source:
Associate the given TimeZone with the current thread,
preserving any Locale that may have been set already.
items.translation: 将给定的时区与当前线程关联，同时保留可能已设置的任何区域设置。

items.source:
Set properties with method names as keys and transaction attribute
descriptors (parsed via TransactionAttributeEditor) as values:
for example, key = "myMethod", value = "PROPAGATION_REQUIRED,readOnly".
items.translation: 使用以方法名为键、事务属性描述符（通过 `TransactionAttributeEditor` 解析）为值的属性：例如，键 = "myMethod"，值 = "PROPAGATION_REQUIRED,readOnly"。

items.source:
Set the transaction attribute source which is used to find transaction
attributes.
items.translation: 设置用于查找事务属性的事务属性源。

items.source:
Set the XA transaction manager to use for wrapping endpoint
invocations, enlisting the endpoint resource in each such transaction.
items.translation: 设置用于包装端点调用的 XA 事务管理器，并将每个此类事务中的端点资源加入其中。

items.source: Specify mappings from type ids to Java classes, if desired.
items.translation: 如有需要，请指定从类型 ID 到 Java 类的映射。

items.source: Set a type id for the given payload object on the given JMS Message.
items.translation: 在给定的 JMS 消息上为给定的负载对象设置类型 ID。

items.source:
Specify the name of the JMS message property that carries the type id for the
contained object: either a mapped id value or a raw Java class name.
items.translation: 指定承载包含对象类型 ID 的 JMS 消息属性名称：即映射的 ID 值或原始 Java 类名。

items.source: Whether to update the 'Content-Length' header of the response.
items.translation: 是否更新响应的 'Content-Length' 标头。

items.source: Set the URIResolver used in the transform.
items.translation: 设置转换中使用的 URIResolver。

items.source: Set the URL of the resource that this view wraps.
items.translation: 设置此视图所包装资源的 URL。

items.source:
Set a Map with URL paths as keys and handler beans (or handler bean names)
as values.
items.translation: 设置一个以 URL 路径为键、处理程序 Bean（或处理程序 Bean 名称）为值的 Map。

items.source: Set whether to use strict casing for attributes.
items.translation: 设置是否对属性使用严格大小写。

items.source: Set whether to use XML validation.
items.translation: 设置是否使用 XML 验证。

items.source: Set parameter values on the given PreparedStatement.
items.translation: 在指定的 PreparedStatement 上设置参数值。

items.source: Set a named variable in this evaluation context to a specified value.
items.translation: 在此评估上下文中将命名变量设置为指定值。

items.source: Set whether to wait for running jobs to complete on shutdown.
items.translation: 设置是否在关闭时等待正在运行的作业完成。

items.source: Set the log category for warn logging.
items.translation: 设置 warn 日志的日志类别。

items.source:
Return whether this holder should be unbound at completion
(or should rather be left bound to the thread after the transaction).
items.translation: 返回此持有器是否应在完成时解除绑定（或者在事务结束后应保留与线程的绑定）。

items.source: Constructor for bean-style configuration.
items.translation: 用于 Bean 风格配置的构造函数。

items.source: Create a new DriverManagerDataSource with the given standard Driver parameters.
items.translation: 使用给定的标准驱动程序参数创建一个新的 DriverManagerDataSource。

items.source: Create a new anonymous SqlParameter, supplying the SQL type.
items.translation: 创建一个新的匿名 SqlParameter，并提供 SQL 类型。

items.source: Create a new SqlParameter, supplying name and SQL type.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 SqlParameter，提供名称和 SQL 类型。

items.source: Create a new SqlParameterValue, supplying the SQL type.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 SqlParameterValue，并提供 SQL 类型。

items.source: Receive first notification of a logical AND predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑与谓词的首次通知。

items.source: Receive first notification of a negated predicate.
items.translation: 接收否定谓词的首次通知。

items.source: Receive first notification of a logical OR predicate.
items.translation: 接收逻辑 OR 谓词的首次通知。

items.source: Return the HTTP status to set the response to.
items.translation: 返回以设置响应的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source: Specify the status to use for the response.
items.translation: 指定要用于响应的状态。

items.source: Contract for access to session counters.
items.translation: 会话计数器访问权限的合同。

items.source: The style pattern to use to format the field or method parameter.
items.translation: 用于格式化字段或方法参数的样式模式。

items.source: Resolves ServerWebExchange-related method argument values of the following types: ServerWebExchange ServerHttpRequest ServerHttpResponse HttpMethod Locale TimeZone ZoneId UriBuilder or UriComponentsBuilder -- for building URL's relative to the current request
items.translation: 解决以下类型的与 ServerWebExchange 相关的方法参数值： ServerWebExchange ServerHttpRequest ServerHttpResponse HttpMethod Locale TimeZone ZoneId UriBuilder 或 UriComponentsBuilder -- 用于构建相对于当前请求的 URL

items.source: in favor of the factory method AnnotationMetadata.introspect(Class). Use MergedAnnotation.asMap from StandardAnnotationMetadata.getAnnotations() rather than AnnotatedTypeMetadata.getAnnotationAttributes(String) if nestedAnnotationsAsMap is false
items.translation: 支持工厂方法AnnotationMetadata.introspect(Class)。如果为false，请使用来自StandardAnnotationMetadata.getAnnotations()的MergedAnnotation.asMap，而不是使用AnnotatedTypeMetadata.getAnnotationAttributes(String)。

items.source: @SpringJUnitWebConfig is a composed annotation that combines @ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class) from JUnit Jupiter with @ContextConfiguration and @WebAppConfiguration from the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: `@SpringJUnitWebConfig` 是一个**组合注解**，它将 JUnit Jupiter 中的 `@ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class)` 与 Spring TestContext Framework 中的 `@ContextConfiguration` 和 `@WebAppConfiguration` 组合在一起。

items.source: A FactoryBean implementation that takes an interface which must have one or more methods with the signatures MyType xxx() or MyType xxx(MyIdType id) (typically, MyService getService() or MyService getService(String id)) and creates a dynamic proxy which implements that interface, delegating to an underlying BeanFactory.
items.translation: 一个 `FactoryBean` 实现，它接收一个接口，该接口必须包含一个或多个签名为 `MyType xxx()` 或 `MyType xxx(MyIdType id)`（通常是 `MyService getService()` 或 `MyService getService(String id)`）的方法，并创建一个实现该接口的动态代理，将调用委托给底层的 `BeanFactory`。

items.source: Set the Map of DataSources; the keys are Strings, the values are actual DataSource instances.
items.translation: 设置一个 `Map`，其类型为 `DataSources`；键为 `Strings`，值为实际的 `DataSource` 实例。

items.source: A simple CacheResolver that resolves the Cache instance(s) based on a configurable CacheManager and the name of the cache(s) as provided by getCacheNames().
items.translation: 一个简单的CacheResolver，它根据可配置的CacheManager以及由getCacheNames()提供的缓存名称，解析Cache实例。

items.source: Strategy implementation for parsing Spring's Caching, Cacheable, CacheEvict, and CachePut annotations.
items.translation: 用于解析 Spring 的 `Caching`、`Cacheable`、`CacheEvict` 和 `CachePut` 注解的策略实现。
返回 `ProxyCachingConfiguration` 或 `AspectJCachingConfiguration`，分别对应 `EnableCaching.mode()` 的 `PROXY` 和 `ASPECTJ` 值。
返回 `ProxyAsyncConfiguration` 或 `AspectJAsyncConfiguration`，分别对应 `EnableAsync.mode()` 的 `PROXY` 和 `ASPECTJ` 值。

items.source: Returns ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration or AspectJ(Jta)TransactionManagementConfiguration for PROXY and ASPECTJ values of EnableTransactionManagement.mode(), respectively.
items.translation: 返回 `ProxyTransactionManagementConfiguration` 或 `AspectJ(Jta)TransactionManagementConfiguration`，分别对应 `EnableTransactionManagement.mode()` 的 `PROXY` 和 `ASPECTJ` 值。

items.source: Filter that parses and caches a RequestPath that can then be accessed via ServletRequestPathUtils.getParsedRequestPath(ServletRequest).
items.translation: Filter 会解析并缓存一个 RequestPath，随后可通过 ServletRequestPathUtils.getParsedRequestPath(ServletRequest) 访问。

items.source: Set the builder ApplicationContext in order to autowire Jackson handlers (JsonSerializer, JsonDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder and TypeIdResolver).
items.translation: 设置构建器中的ApplicationContext以自动注入 Jackson 处理器（JsonSerializer、JsonDeserializer、KeyDeserializer、TypeResolverBuilder和TypeIdResolver）。

items.source: Indicates whether Spring should ensure that ObjectNames generated by the configured ObjectNamingStrategy for runtime-registered MBeans (MBeanExporter.registerManagedResource(Object)) should get modified: to ensure uniqueness for every instance of a managed Class.
items.translation: 指示 Spring 是否应确保由配置的ObjectNamingStrategy生成的ObjectName（针对运行时注册的 MBeans，即MBeanExporter.registerManagedResource(Object)）进行修改：以确保每个受管理的Class实例的唯一性。

items.source: @SpringJUnitConfig is a composed annotation that combines @ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class) from JUnit Jupiter with @ContextConfiguration from the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: @SpringJUnitConfig 是一个 组合注解，它结合了来自 JUnit Jupiter 的 @ExtendWith(SpringExtension.class) 和来自 Spring TestContext Framework 的 @ContextConfiguration。

items.source: TestExecutionListener that provides support for executing SQL scripts and inlined statements configured via the @Sql annotation.
items.translation: 提供对通过 `@Sql` 注解配置的 SQL scripts 和行内 statements 执行支持的TestExecutionListener。

items.source: as of 6.2, in favor of direct ResultSet.getSQLXML(int) and Connection.createSQLXML() usage, possibly in combination with a custom SqlValue implementation
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，推荐使用直接的ResultSet.getSQLXML(int)和Connection.createSQLXML()用法，可能还会结合自定义的SqlValue实现。

items.source: FactoryBean that sets up a ScheduledExecutorService (by default: a ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor) and exposes it for bean references.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于设置一个 ScheduledExecutorService（默认值：一个 ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor），并将其暴露以供 bean 引用。

items.source: Sets the default view class to ScriptTemplateViewResolver.requiredViewClass(): by default ScriptTemplateView.
items.translation: 将默认的视图类设置为ScriptTemplateViewResolver.requiredViewClass()： 默认为ScriptTemplateView。

items.source: Sets the default view class to ScriptTemplateViewResolver.requiredViewClass(): by default ScriptTemplateView.
items.translation: 将默认的视图类设置为ScriptTemplateViewResolver.requiredViewClass()： 默认为ScriptTemplateView。

items.source: A HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler for sending to destinations specified in a SendTo or SendToUser method-level annotations.
items.translation: 用于向在 `SendTo` 或 `SendToUser` 方法级注解中指定的目的地发送消息的 `HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler`。

items.source: Reader that supports a stream of ServerSentEvents and also plain Objects which is the same as an ServerSentEvent with data only.
items.translation: 支持 `ServerSentEvents` 流以及普通 Objects（等同于仅包含数据的 ServerSentEvent）的阅读器。

items.source: A Servlet-specific AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter that creates a NativeWebRequest from ServletRequestAttributes.
items.translation: 一个 Servlet 专用的AbstractWebArgumentResolverAdapter，它从ServletRequestAttributes创建NativeWebRequest。

items.source: Setting an ApplicationContext is optional: If set, Reactor resources will be initialized in the lifecycle start phase and closed in the lifecycle stop phase.
items.translation: 设置 `ApplicationContext` 是可选的：如果已设置，Reactor 资源将在 `lifecycle start` 阶段初始化，并在 `lifecycle stop` 阶段关闭。
设置 `ApplicationContext` 是可选的：如果设置了，注册的将在 `ContextRefreshedEvent` 阶段激活；如果没有设置，则会在 `ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor.afterSingletonsInstantiated()` 时发生。

items.source: Making a BeanFactory available is optional; if not set, JmsListenerConfigurer beans won't get autodetected and an endpoint registry has to be explicitly configured.
items.translation: 使 `BeanFactory` 可用是可选的；如果不设置，`JmsListenerConfigurer` Bean 将不会被自动检测，并且必须显式配置一个 `endpoint registry`。

items.source: Making a BeanFactory available is optional; if not set, SchedulingConfigurer beans won't get autodetected and a scheduler has to be explicitly configured.
items.translation: 使BeanFactory可用是可选的；如果不设置，SchedulingConfigurer 组件将不会被自动检测，并且必须显式配置一个scheduler。

items.source: Set a custom BeanNameGenerator for use with AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader and/or ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner.
items.translation: 为 `BeanNameGenerator` 设置自定义生成器，供 `AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader` 和/或 `ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner` 使用。

items.source: Provide a custom BeanNameGenerator for use with AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader and/or ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner, if any.
items.translation: 如有需要，请为 `AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader` 和/或 `ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner` 提供一个自定义的 BeanNameGenerator。

items.source: Set the BeanNameGenerator to be used when triggering component scanning from Configuration classes and when registering Import'ed configuration classes.
items.translation: 设置 `BeanNameGenerator` 以在从 `Configuration` 类触发组件扫描以及注册 `Import` 的配置文件类时使用。

items.source: Configure the set of custom converter objects that should be added: implementing Converter, ConverterFactory, or GenericConverter.
items.translation: 配置要添加的自定义转换器对象集：实现Converter、ConverterFactory或GenericConverter。

items.source: Set the field with the given name/type on the provided targetObject/targetClass to the supplied value.
items.translation: 设置提供的 `targetObject`/`targetClass` 上具有给定 `name`/`type` 的 field 为提供的 `value`。

items.source: Set whether to operate on a Hibernate-managed Session instead of a Spring-managed Session, that is, whether to obtain the Session through Hibernate's SessionFactory.getCurrentSession() instead of SessionFactory.openSession() (with a Spring TransactionSynchronizationManager check preceding it).
items.translation: 设置是否对 Hibernate 管理的 Session 进行操作，而不是对 Spring 管理的 Session 进行操作，即是否通过 Hibernate 的 SessionFactory.getCurrentSession() 获取 Session，而不是通过 SessionFactory.openSession()（其前带有 Spring TransactionSynchronizationManager 检查）。

items.source: Default implementation of LocaleResolver.setLocale(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Locale) that delegates to LocaleContextResolver.setLocaleContext(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, LocaleContext), using a SimpleLocaleContext.
items.translation: 默认实现 `LocaleResolver.setLocale(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, Locale)`，委托给使用 `SimpleLocaleContext 的`LocaleContextResolver.setLocaleContext(HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse, LocaleContext)`。

items.source: Set the ObjectName-style name of the single MBean that the encapsulated NotificationFilter will be registered with to listen for Notifications.
items.translation: 设置封装的 `NotificationFilter` 将注册以监听 `Notifications` 的单个 MBean 的 `ObjectName` 风格名称。

items.source: Set an array of ObjectName-style names of the MBeans that the encapsulated NotificationFilter will be registered with to listen for Notifications.
items.translation: 设置一个数组，包含封装的 NotificationFilter 将注册以监听 Notifications 的 MBean 的 ObjectName 风格名称。

items.source: Set the NotificationListenerBeans containing the NotificationListeners that will be registered with the MBeanServer.
items.translation: 设置包含将注册到 MBeanServer 的 NotificationListeners 的 NotificationListenerBeans。

items.source: Set a custom ScopeMetadataResolver for use with AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader and/or ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner.
items.translation: 为 `ScopeMetadataResolver` 设置自定义实现，以便与 `AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader` 和/或 `ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner` 一起使用。

items.source: HandlerAdapter that allows using the plain WebHandler contract with the generic DispatcherHandler.
items.translation: 允许使用普通的WebHandler契约与通用的DispatcherHandler的HandlerAdapter。

items.source: A Supplier decorator that caches a singleton result and makes it available from SingletonSupplier.get() (nullable) and SingletonSupplier.obtain() (null-safe).
items.translation: 一个 `Supplier` 装饰器，用于缓存单个结果，并通过 SingletonSupplier.get()（可为 null）和 SingletonSupplier.obtain()（非空安全）提供该结果。

items.source: A specialization of HttpMessageConverter that can convert an HTTP request into a target object of a specified ResolvableType and a source object of a specified ResolvableType into an HTTP response with optional hints.
items.translation: 一种 `HttpMessageConverter` 的特化类，能够将 HTTP 请求转换为指定 ResolvableType 的目标对象，并将指定 ResolvableType 的源对象转换为带有可选提示的 HTTP 响应。

items.source: Extended variant of a RequestBuilder that applies its org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessors as a separate step from the RequestBuilder.buildRequest(ServletContext) method.
items.translation: `RequestBuilder` 接口的扩展变体，它将 `org.springframework.test.web.servlet.request.RequestPostProcessors` 作为与 `RequestBuilder.buildRequest(ServletContext)` 方法分开的独立步骤进行应用。

items.source: Common SqlValue implementation for JDBC Array creation based on the JDBC 4 Connection.createArrayOf(String, Object[]) method.
items.translation: 用于基于 JDBC 4 Connection.createArrayOf(String, Object[]) 方法创建 JDBC Array 的常用SqlValue实现。

items.source: ResultSetExtractor implementation that returns a Spring SqlRowSet representation for each given ResultSet.
items.translation: ResultSetExtractor 实现，它为每个给定的 ResultSet 返回一个 Spring SqlRowSet表示。

items.source: A basic TypeComparator implementation: supports comparison of Number types as well as types implementing Comparable.
items.translation: 一个基本的TypeComparator实现：支持比较Number类型以及实现Comparable的类型。

items.source: A simple implementation of TypeLocator that uses the default ClassLoader or a supplied ClassLoader to locate types.
items.translation: 一个简单实现 TypeLocator 的类，它使用默认的 ClassLoader 或提供的 ClassLoader 来定位类型。

items.source: TcpMessageCodec for STOMP, delegating to StompDecoder and StompEncoder.
items.translation: 用于 STOMP 的 TcpMessageCodec，委托给 StompDecoder 和 StompEncoder。

items.source: An implementation of WebSocketHandler that delegates incoming WebSocket messages to a SubProtocolHandler along with a MessageChannel to which the sub-protocol handler can send messages from WebSocket clients to the application.
items.translation: 一个 `WebSocketHandler` 的实现，它将传入的 WebSocket 消息委托给一个 `SubProtocolHandler`，并附带一个 `MessageChannel`，子协议处理程序可以通过该通道将来自 WebSocket 客户端的消息发送到应用程序。

items.source: Determine if the value for the Parameter in the supplied ParameterContext should be autowired from the test's ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 确定是否应从测试的ApplicationContext自动注入在提供的ParameterContext中的Parameter的值。

items.source: Determine whether to suppress System.getenv()/System.getenv(String) access for the purposes of AbstractEnvironment.getSystemEnvironment().
items.translation: 确定是否抑制 `System.getenv()/System.getenv(String)` 的访问，以用于 `AbstractEnvironment.getSystemEnvironment()`。

items.source: Extension of HandlerMethod that invokes the underlying method via InvocableHandlerMethod but uses sync argument resolvers only and thus can return directly a HandlerResult with no async wrappers.
items.translation: 扩展了通过HandlerMethod调用底层方法的类，但仅使用同步参数解析器，因此可以直接返回一个HandlerResult，无需任何异步包装。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers a ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor bean capable of processing Spring's @Scheduled annotation.
items.translation: `@Configuration` 类注册了一个 `ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor` Bean，该 Bean 能够处理 Spring 的 `@Scheduled` 注解。

items.source: Inserts an attribute in the Reactor Context that makes the current ServerWebExchange available under the attribute name ServerWebExchangeContextFilter.EXCHANGE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE.
items.translation: 在 Reactor Context 中插入一个属性，使当前的 ServerWebExchange 可在属性名称 ServerWebExchangeContextFilter.EXCHANGE_CONTEXT_ATTRIBUTE 下可用。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes all services for the configured service class, represented as a List of service objects, obtained through the JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: FactoryBean 暴露了配置的服务类的所有服务，表示为通过 JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader 设施获取的服务对象列表。

items.source: Extends InvocableHandlerMethod with the ability to handle return values through a registered HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler and also supports setting the response status based on a method-level @ResponseStatus annotation.
items.translation: 扩展 InvocableHandlerMethod，使其能够通过注册的 HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler 处理返回值，并且支持根据方法级别的 @ResponseStatus 注解设置响应状态。

items.source: Variant of ServletInvocableHandlerMethod(Object, Method) that also accepts a MessageSource, for example, to resolve @ResponseStatus messages with.
items.translation: `ServletInvocableHandlerMethod(Object, Method)` 的变体，它还接受一个 MessageSource，例如用于解析 `@ResponseStatus` 消息。

items.source: This callback is only required for resolution of bean names in the "beans" Map and for auto-detection of MBeans (in the latter case, a ListableBeanFactory is required).
items.translation: 此回调仅在解析 `"beans" Map 中的 Bean 名称以及自动检测 MBeans（在后一种情况下，需要 `ListableBeanFactory`）时是必需的。

items.source: Set the JmsListenerContainerFactory to use in case a JmsListenerEndpoint is registered with a null container factory.
items.translation: 设置JmsListenerContainerFactory，以便在将JmsListenerEndpoint注册为null容器工厂时使用。

items.source: Set the bean name of the JmsListenerContainerFactory to use in case a JmsListenerEndpoint is registered with a null container factory.
items.translation: 将JmsListenerContainerFactory的 Bean 名称设置为在注册了具有null容器工厂的JmsListenerEndpoint时使用的值。

items.source: Set the ScriptEngine supplier to use by the view, usually used with ScriptTemplateConfigurer.setSharedEngine(Boolean) set to false.
items.translation: 将视图使用的 `ScriptEngine` 供应商设置好，通常与 ScriptTemplateConfigurer.setSharedEngine(Boolean) 设置为 false 一起使用。

items.source: Set the ScriptEngine supplier to use by the view, usually used with ScriptTemplateConfigurer.setSharedEngine(Boolean) set to false.
items.translation: 将视图使用的 `ScriptEngine` 供应商设置好，通常与将 `ScriptTemplateConfigurer.setSharedEngine(Boolean)` 设置为 `false` 一起使用。

items.source: Propagate the given custom Environment to the underlying AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader and ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner.
items.translation: 将给定的自定义Environment传播到其底层的AnnotatedBeanDefinitionReader和ClassPathBeanDefinitionScanner。

items.source: Set the static field with the given name/type on the provided targetClass to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定的 `name`/type 的静态 field 设置到提供的 `targetClass` 上，值为提供的 `value`。

items.source: Set the field with the given name/type on the provided targetObject to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定 `name`/`type` 的field设置到提供的 `targetObject`》上的指定 `value`。`

items.source: Customize the construction of Jackson handlers (JsonSerializer, JsonDeserializer, KeyDeserializer, TypeResolverBuilder and TypeIdResolver).
items.translation: 自定义 Jackson 处理程序（`JsonSerializer`、`JsonDeserializer`、`KeyDeserializer`、`TypeResolverBuilder` 和 `TypeIdResolver`）的构建。

items.source: Set the Collection, Map or array of objects used to generate the inner 'option' tags.
items.translation: 设置用于生成内部 `option` 标签的`Collection`、`Map` 或对象数组。

items.source: Set the Collection, Map or array of objects used to generate the 'input type="checkbox/radio"' tags.
items.translation: 设置用于生成 `input type="checkbox/radio"` 标签的`Collection`、`Map` 或对象数组。

items.source: Set the Collection, Map or array of objects used to generate the inner 'option' tags.
items.translation: 设置用于生成内部 `option` 标签的 Collection、Map 或对象数组。

items.source: An alternative to the more commonly used RdbmsOperation.setDataSource(DataSource) when you want to use the same JdbcTemplate in multiple RdbmsOperations.
items.translation: 当需要在多个 `RdbmsOperations` 中使用相同的 `JdbcTemplate` 时，这是比更常用的 `RdbmsOperation.setDataSource(DataSource)` 的替代方案。

items.source: Set the MessageConverter to use to convert a Message to and from a Message.
items.translation: 设置用于将 `MessageConverter` 转换为 `Message` 和从 `Message` 转换的转换器。

items.source: By default, when MessageHeaderAccessor.getMessageHeaders() is called, "this" MessageHeaderAccessor instance can no longer be used to modify the underlying message headers and the returned MessageHeaders is immutable.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当调用MessageHeaderAccessor.getMessageHeaders()时，"this"MessageHeaderAccessor实例将不能再用于修改底层消息头，且返回的MessageHeaders是不可变的。

items.source: Set the ObjectName used to register the JMXConnectorServer itself with the MBeanServer, as ObjectName instance or as String.
items.translation: 设置用于将 `JMXConnectorServer` 本身注册到 `MBeanServer` 的 `ObjectName`，可以是 `ObjectName` 实例或 `String`。

items.source: Configure an ObservationConvention that sets the name of the observation as well as its KeyValues extracted from the ClientRequestObservationContext.
items.translation: 配置一个 `ObservationConvention`，该约定将设置 `observation` 的名称以及从 `ClientRequestObservationContext` 提取的其 `KeyValues`。

items.source: Set the TaskScheduler to register scheduled tasks with, or a ScheduledExecutorService to be wrapped as a TaskScheduler.
items.translation: 设置用于注册定时任务的 TaskScheduler，或一个将被包装为 TaskScheduler 的 ScheduledExecutorService。

items.source: Provide a Predicate to perform supported version checks with, in effect taking over the supported version check and superseding the ApiVersionConfigurer.addSupportedVersions(String...) and ApiVersionConfigurer.detectSupportedVersions.
items.translation: 提供一个 `Predicate` 来执行受支持的版本检查，从而接管受支持的版本检查并取代 `ApiVersionConfigurer.addSupportedVersions(String...)` 和 `ApiVersionConfigurer.detectSupportedVersions`。

items.source: Provide a Predicate to perform supported version checks with, in effect taking over the supported version check and superseding the ApiVersionConfigurer.addSupportedVersions(String...) and ApiVersionConfigurer.detectSupportedVersions.
items.translation: 提供一个Predicate来执行受支持的版本检查，实际上接管了受支持的版本检查并取代了ApiVersionConfigurer.addSupportedVersions(String...)和ApiVersionConfigurer.detectSupportedVersions。

items.source: When ContentNegotiationManagerFactoryBean.setFavorParameter(boolean) is set, this property determines whether to use only registered MediaType mappings or to allow dynamic resolution, for example, via MediaTypeFactory.
items.translation: 当设置ContentNegotiationManagerFactoryBean.setFavorParameter(boolean)时，此属性决定是仅使用已注册的MediaType映射，还是允许动态解析，例如通过MediaTypeFactory。

items.source: A simple DestinationResolver implementation for Session-based destination resolution, caching Queue and Topic instances per queue/topic name.
items.translation: 一个简单的针对基于 `Session` 的目标解析的DestinationResolver实现，按队列/主题名称缓存Queue和Topic实例。

items.source: A simple CacheResolver that resolves the exception cache based on a configurable CacheManager and the name of the cache: CacheResultOperation.getExceptionCacheName().
items.translation: 一个简单的CacheResolver，它基于可配置的CacheManager和缓存名称（即：CacheResultOperation.getExceptionCacheName()）来解析异常缓存。

items.source: Create a SimpleValueStyler using the SimpleValueStyler.DEFAULT_CLASS_STYLER and SimpleValueStyler.DEFAULT_METHOD_STYLER.
items.translation: 使用SimpleValueStyler.DEFAULT_CLASS_STYLER和SimpleValueStyler.DEFAULT_METHOD_STYLER创建一个SimpleValueStyler。

items.source: Create a new SingleConnectionFactory with a given Connection and ConnectionFactoryMetadata.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 SingleConnectionFactory，给定一个 Connection 和 ConnectionFactoryMetadata。

items.source: Sets the supportedMediaTypes to text/xml and application/xml, and application/*+xml.
items.translation: 将 `supportedMediaTypes` 设置为 `text/xml`、`application/xml` 以及 `application/*+xml`。

items.source: @Sql is used to annotate a test class or test method to configure SQL Sql.scripts() and Sql.statements() to be executed against a given database during integration tests.
items.translation: @Sql 用于注解测试类或测试方法，以配置 SQL Sql.scripts() 和 Sql.statements()，以便在集成测试期间针对给定的数据库执行。

items.source: Use the given WebAsyncTask to configure the task executor as well as the timeout value of the AsyncWebRequest before delegating to WebAsyncManager.startCallableProcessing(Callable, Object...).
items.translation: 使用给定的 WebAsyncTask 配置任务执行器以及 AsyncWebRequest 的超时值，然后再委托给 WebAsyncManager.startCallableProcessing(Callable, Object...)。

items.source: Subscribe to given Publisher of DataBuffers, and return an InputStream to consume the byte content with.
items.translation: 订阅给定的 Publisher（用于 DataBuffers），并返回一个 InputStream 以消耗字节内容。

items.source: Can this Validator validate instances of the supplied clazz?
items.translation: 这个 `Validator validate` 实例可以验证提供的 `clazz` 吗？

items.source: Synthesize an annotation from the supplied annotation by wrapping it in a dynamic proxy that transparently enforces attribute alias semantics for annotation attributes that are annotated with @AliasFor.
items.translation: Synthesize 一个注解，通过将其包装在动态代理中来实现，该代理透明地强制对使用 @AliasFor 注解的注解属性执行属性别名语义。

items.source: Synthesize an annotation from the supplied map of annotation attributes by wrapping the map in a dynamic proxy that implements an annotation of the specified annotationType and transparently enforces attribute alias semantics for annotation attributes that are annotated with @AliasFor.
items.translation: Synthesize 一个注解，通过用动态代理包装提供的注解属性映射来实现指定 annotationType 的注解，并透明地强制实施带有 @AliasFor 注解的注解属性的属性别名语义。

items.source: Convenience method that retrieves the "output" FlashMap, updates it with the path and query params of the target URL, and then saves it using the FlashMapManager.
items.translation: 用于获取"output" FlashMap的便捷方法，使用目标 URL 的路径和查询参数对其进行更新，然后使用FlashMapManager将其保存。

items.source: Extension of the GenericBeanDefinition class, based on an ASM ClassReader, with support for annotation metadata exposed through the AnnotatedBeanDefinition interface.
items.translation: 基于 ASM ClassReader 扩展的GenericBeanDefinition类，支持通过AnnotatedBeanDefinition接口暴露的注解元数据。

items.source: Bean post-processor that registers methods annotated with @Scheduled to be invoked by a TaskScheduler according to the "fixedRate", "fixedDelay", or "cron" expression provided via the annotation.
items.translation: 注册带有@Scheduled注解的方法，以便由TaskScheduler根据通过注解提供的"fixedRate"、"fixedDelay"或"cron"表达式进行调用的 Bean 后置处理器。

items.source: FactoryBean that creates and configures a Quartz Scheduler, manages its lifecycle as part of the Spring application context, and exposes the Scheduler as bean reference for dependency injection.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于创建和配置 Quartz Scheduler，将其生命周期作为 Spring 应用程序上下文的一部分进行管理，并将 Scheduler 暴露为依赖注入的 bean 引用。

items.source: Optional interface to be implemented by @Configuration classes annotated with @EnableScheduling.
items.translation: 由带有@EnableScheduling注解的@Configuration类实现的可选接口。

items.source: Return a ValueCodeGenerator that is scoped for the specified GeneratedMethods.
items.translation: 返回一个针对指定的 GeneratedMethods 范围的 ValueCodeGenerator。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that handles ScriptFactory definitions, replacing each factory with the actual scripted Java object generated by it.
items.translation: 处理 `ScriptFactory` 定义的`BeanPostProcessor`，将每个工厂替换为由其生成的实际脚本化 Java 对象。

items.source: Convenience subclass of UrlBasedViewResolver that supports ScriptTemplateView and custom subclasses of it.
items.translation: `UrlBasedViewResolver` 的便捷子类，支持 `ScriptTemplateView` 及其自定义子类。

items.source: Convenience subclass of UrlBasedViewResolver that supports ScriptTemplateView and custom subclasses of it.
items.translation: `UrlBasedViewResolver` 的便捷子类，支持 `ScriptTemplateView` 及其自定义子类。

items.source: A convenience constructor that allows for specifying prefix and suffix as constructor arguments.
items.translation: 一个便捷构造函数，允许将prefix和suffix指定为构造函数参数。

items.source: A convenience constructor that allows for specifying prefix and suffix as constructor arguments.
items.translation: 一个便利构造函数，允许将prefix和suffix指定为构造函数参数。

items.source: This implementation resolves the type of annotation from generic metadata and validates that (a) the annotation is in fact present on the importing @Configuration class and (b) that the given annotation has an advice mode attribute of type AdviceMode.
items.translation: 此实现从通用元数据中解析注解类型，并验证 (a) 该注解确实存在于导入的 `@Configuration` 类上，以及 (b) 给定的注解具有类型为 advice mode attribute 的 AdviceMode。

items.source: Select and return the names of which class(es) should be imported based on the AnnotationMetadata of the importing @Configuration class.
items.translation: 根据导入的 AnnotationMetadata 的 <@Configuration>Configuration 类，选择并返回应导入的类名。

items.source: An overloaded version of StompSession.send(String, Object) with full StompHeaders instead of just a destination.
items.translation: 带有完整 StompHeaders 的 StompSession.send(String, Object) 重载版本，而不仅仅是目的地。

items.source: Send a WebSocket message: either TextMessage or BinaryMessage.
items.translation: 发送 WebSocket 消息：`TextMessage` 或 `BinaryMessage`。

items.source: Send the supplied Notification using the wrapped ModelMBean instance.
items.translation: 使用包装的ModelMBean实例发送提供的Notification。

items.source: Send the specified Notification to all registered NotificationListeners.
items.translation: 将指定的 Notification 发送给所有已注册的 NotificationListeners。

items.source: Wrapper for the native IOException (or similar) when a Serializer or Deserializer failed.
items.translation: 原生 `IOException`（或类似异常）的包装器，当 `Serializer` 或 `Deserializer` 失败时抛出。

items.source: A Converter that delegates to a Serializer to convert an object to a byte array.
items.translation: 一个委托给 Serializer 的Converter，用于将对象转换为字节数组。

items.source: Implementation of the ServerRequest interface that can be subclassed to adapt the request in a handler filter function.
items.translation: 实现可被继承以在 handler filter function 中适配请求的 ServerRequest 接口。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes the 'primary' service for the configured service class, obtained through the JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader facility.
items.translation: FactoryBean 暴露配置的服务类对应的'primary'服务，该服务通过 JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader 设施获取。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes the JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader for the configured service class.
items.translation: FactoryBean 暴露了用于配置的服务类的 JDK 1.6 ServiceLoader。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor implementation that passes the ServletContext to beans that implement the ServletContextAware interface.
items.translation: 实现 `BeanPostProcessor` 的 Bean，将 ServletContext 传递给实现了`ServletContextAware` 接口的 Bean。

items.source: A Servlet-specific ModelAttributeMethodProcessor that applies data binding through a WebDataBinder of type ServletRequestDataBinder.
items.translation: 一个特定于 Servlet 的ModelAttributeMethodProcessor，它通过类型为ServletRequestDataBinder的 WebDataBinder 应用数据绑定。

items.source: Constructor accepting a request and response pair that are expected to be of type ServletServerHttpRequest and ServletServerHttpResponse respectively.
items.translation: 接受请求和响应对的构造函数，预期其类型分别为ServletServerHttpRequest和ServletServerHttpResponse。

items.source: TestExecutionListener which provides mock Servlet API support to WebApplicationContexts loaded by the Spring TestContext Framework.
items.translation: TestExecutionListener 为通过 Spring TestContext Framework 加载的 WebApplicationContexts 提供模拟 Servlet API 支持。

items.source: Configure the WebSessionManager to set on the WebServerExchange.
items.translation: 配置 WebSessionManager 以设置在 WebServerExchange 上。

items.source: Resolves a SessionStatus argument by obtaining it from the ModelAndViewContainer.
items.translation: 通过从ModelAndViewContainer获取它来解析一个SessionStatus参数。

items.source: Resolver for a SessionStatus argument obtaining it from the BindingContext.
items.translation: 用于从 BindingContext 获取 SessionStatus 参数的解析器。

items.source: Variant of HttpHeaders.setAcceptLanguage(List) using Locale's.
items.translation: `HttpHeaders.setAcceptLanguage(List)` 的变体，使用 `Locale`。

items.source: Convert String into Properties, considering it as properties content.
items.translation: 将 `String` 转换为 `Properties，将其视为属性内容。

items.source: Switches the context ClassLoader for the managed resources ClassLoader before allowing the invocation to occur.
items.translation: 在允许调用发生之前，为受管理的资源 ClassLoader 切换 context ClassLoader。

items.source: Set a Hibernate BeanContainer for the given Spring ConfigurableListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: 为给定的 Spring ConfigurableListableBeanFactory 设置一个 Hibernate BeanContainer。

items.source: Set the containing BeanFactory for CacheManager and other service lookups.
items.translation: 设置包含 `BeanFactory` 的 `CacheManager` 和其他服务查找。

items.source: A BeanFactory only needs to be available in conjunction with JmsListenerEndpointRegistrar.setContainerFactoryBeanName(String).
items.translation: `BeanFactory` 仅在配合使用 `JmsListenerEndpointRegistrar.setContainerFactoryBeanName(String)` 时才需要可用。

items.source: Accept the containing BeanFactory, registering corresponding Hibernate BeanContainer integration for it if possible.
items.translation: 接受包含 BeanFactory 的容器，如果可能的话，为其注册相应的 Hibernate BeanContainer 集成。

items.source: Set the Executor (possibly a TaskExecutor) for background bootstrapping.
items.translation: 设置用于后台引导的Executor（可能是TaskExecutor）。

items.source: Specify a callback for customizing the Bean Validation Configuration instance, as an alternative to overriding the LocalValidatorFactoryBean.postProcessConfiguration(Configuration) method in custom LocalValidatorFactoryBean subclasses.
items.translation: 指定一个回调以自定义 Bean Validation `` 配置实例，作为在自定义 `` 子类中重写 `LocalValidatorFactoryBean.postProcessConfiguration(Configuration)` 方法的替代方案。

items.source: Set the Map of ConnectionFactories.
items.translation: 设置 Map 的 ConnectionFactories。

items.source: Set the ConnectionFactoryLookup implementation to use for resolving connection factory name Strings in the targetConnectionFactories map.
items.translation: 将 `ConnectionFactoryLookup` 实现设置为用于解析 `targetConnectionFactories` 映射中的连接工厂名称字符串。

items.source: Variant of ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory.setConnectTimeout(int) with a Duration value.
items.translation: `ReactorClientHttpRequestFactory.setConnectTimeout(int)` 的变体，使用 `Duration` 值。

items.source: Configure a custom CorsProcessor to use to apply the matched CorsConfiguration for a request.
items.translation: 配置自定义 CorsProcessor 以用于为请求应用匹配的 CorsConfiguration。

items.source: Specify the custom editors to register via a Map, using the class name of the required type as the key and the class name of the associated PropertyEditor as value.
items.translation: 通过 `Map` 注册自定义编辑器，使用所需类型的类名作为键，关联的 `PropertyEditor` 的类名作为值。

items.source: Set the WebDataBinderFactory to be passed to argument resolvers allowing them to create a WebDataBinder for data binding and type conversion purposes.
items.translation: 将 `WebDataBinderFactory` 设置为传递给参数解析器的参数，以便它们能够创建用于数据绑定和类型转换的 `WebDataBinder`。

items.source: Set the DataBufferFactory to use for Resource loading.
items.translation: 设置用于 `DataBufferFactory` 的 `Resource` 加载。

items.source: Configure the Executor to use for HttpClient exchanges.
items.translation: 配置用于 `Executor` 的 `HttpClient` 交换。

items.source: Set whether to expose the listener JMS Session to a registered SessionAwareMessageListener as well as to JmsTemplate calls.
items.translation: 设置是否将监听器 JMS Session 暴露给已注册的 SessionAwareMessageListener 以及 JmsTemplate 调用。

items.source: Set whether the proxy should be exposed by the AOP framework as a ThreadLocal for retrieval via the AopContext class.
items.translation: 设置 AOP 框架是否将代理作为 `ThreadLocal` 暴露，以便通过 `AopContext` 类进行检索。

items.source: Set whether to expose the Spring-managed Scheduler instance in the Quartz SchedulerRepository.
items.translation: 设置是否在 Quartz SchedulerRepository 中暴露由 Spring 管理的 Scheduler 实例。

items.source: Set additional patterns to use as a fallback in case parsing fails for the configured pattern, ISO format, style, or style pattern.
items.translation: 设置额外的模式，以便在配置的pattern、ISO 格式、style或style pattern解析失败时作为后备使用。

items.source: Set the static field with the given name on the provided targetClass to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定的 `name` 的静态 field 设置到提供的 targetClass 上，值为提供的 value。

items.source: Set the field with the given name on the provided targetObject to the supplied value.
items.translation: 将给定 `name` 的field设置到提供的 `targetObject` 上，值为提供的 `value`。

items.source: Configure the set of FormatterRegistrars to invoke to register Converters and Formatters in addition to those added declaratively via FormattingConversionServiceFactoryBean.setConverters(Set) and FormattingConversionServiceFactoryBean.setFormatters(Set).
items.translation: 配置要调用以注册转换器（Converters）和格式化器（Formatters）的 FormatterRegistrars 集合，除了通过 FormattingConversionServiceFactoryBean.setConverters(Set) 和 FormattingConversionServiceFactoryBean.setFormatters(Set) 声明式添加的那些之外。

items.source: Set the (arbitrary) object that will be 'handed back' as-is by an NotificationBroadcaster when notifying any NotificationListener.
items.translation: 设置一个（任意的）对象，当通知任何 NotificationListener 时，该对象将由 NotificationBroadcaster 原样“交回”。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to pass on to HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers that send messages from controller return values.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 传递给将控制器返回值发送为消息的`HandlerMethodReturnValueHandlers`。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of Messages from decoded STOMP frames.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 以应用于解码后的 STOMP 帧中`Messages`的标头。

items.source: By default, when MessageHeaderAccessor.getMessageHeaders() is called, "this" MessageHeaderAccessor instance can no longer be used to modify the underlying message headers.
items.translation: 默认情况下，当调用MessageHeaderAccessor.getMessageHeaders()时，"this"MessageHeaderAccessor实例将不能再用于修改底层消息头。

items.source: Specify the default isolation level to use for Connection retrieval, according to the JDBC Connection constants (equivalent to the corresponding Spring TransactionDefinition constants).
items.translation: 指定用于 Connection 检索的默认隔离级别，依据 JDBC Connection 常量（相当于相应的 Spring TransactionDefinition 常量）。

items.source: Set the jitter value to apply for each interval, leading to random milliseconds to be subtracted or added and resulting in a value between interval - jitter and interval + jitter but never below initialInterval or above maxInterval.
items.translation: 设置每个间隔要应用的抖动值，导致随机毫秒被减去或加上，从而产生介于 `interval - jitter` 和 `interval + jitter` 之间的值，但永远不会低于 `initialInterval` 或高于 `maxInterval`。

items.source: Specify the factory for objects to be injected into @Resource / @EJB annotated fields and setter methods, for mappedName attributes that point directly into JNDI.
items.translation: 指定要注入到带有 `@Resource` / `@EJB` 注解的字段和 setter 方法的工厂，针对直接指向 JNDI 的 mappedName 属性。

items.source: Specify whether to apply a lenient fallback to the default ConnectionFactory if no specific ConnectionFactory could be found for the current lookup key.
items.translation: 指定是否对当前查找键无法找到特定的 ConnectionFactory 时，对默认 ConnectionFactory 应用宽松的回退。

items.source: Set the LoadTimeWeaver of this object's containing ApplicationContext.
items.translation: 设置此对象包含的 ApplicationContext 的 LoadTimeWeaver。

items.source: The maximum number of attempts after which a call to BackOffExecution.nextBackOff() returns BackOffExecution.STOP.
items.translation: 调用BackOffExecution.nextBackOff()后返回BackOffExecution.STOP的最大尝试次数。

items.source: Set the maximum elapsed time in milliseconds after which a call to BackOffExecution.nextBackOff() returns BackOffExecution.STOP.
items.translation: 设置最大经过时间（毫秒），在此时间之后，对BackOffExecution.nextBackOff()的调用将返回BackOffExecution.STOP。

items.source: Set the MessageHandlerMethodFactory to use to build the InvocableHandlerMethod responsible to manage the invocation of this endpoint.
items.translation: 将 `MessageHandlerMethodFactory` 设置为用于构建负责管理此端点调用的`InvocableHandlerMethod`。

items.source: Specify a Hibernate MetadataSources service to use (for example, reusing an existing one), potentially populated with a custom Hibernate bootstrap ServiceRegistry as well.
items.translation: 指定要使用的 Hibernate MetadataSources 服务（例如，重用现有的一个），并可能使用自定义的 Hibernate 引导 ServiceRegistry 对其进行填充。

items.source: Set a name/attribute map, consisting of "<fully-qualified class name>.<method-name>" method names (for example, "com.mycompany.mycode.MyClass.myMethod") and TransactionAttribute instances (or Strings to be converted to TransactionAttribute instances).
items.translation: 设置一个名称/属性映射，其中包含"<fully-qualified class name>.<method-name>"方法名（例如，"com.mycompany.mycode.MyClass.myMethod"）和 TransactionAttribute 实例（或要转换为TransactionAttribute 实例的字符串）。

items.source: Set the misfire instruction for this trigger via the name of the corresponding constant in the Trigger and CronTrigger classes.
items.translation: 通过 `Trigger` 和 `CronTrigger` 类中相应常量的名称，设置此触发器的失火指令。

items.source: Set the misfire instruction for this trigger via the name of the corresponding constant in the Trigger and SimpleTrigger classes.
items.translation: 通过 `Trigger` 和 `SimpleTrigger` 类中相应常量的名称，设置此触发器的未命中指令。

items.source: Set the NotificationFilter associated with the encapsulated NotificationFilter.
items.translation: 设置与封装的NotificationFilter关联的NotificationFilter。

items.source: Set the NotificationListeners to register with the MBeanServer.
items.translation: 将 `NotificationListeners` 设置为向 `MBeanServer` 注册。

items.source: Enable use of parsed PathPatterns as described in AbstractHandlerMapping.setPatternParser(PathPatternParser).
items.translation: 启用已解析的 PathPatterns，用法如 AbstractHandlerMapping.setPatternParser(PathPatternParser) 所述。

items.source: Indicate whether IllegalArgumentException and AspectJAdviceParameterNameDiscoverer.AmbiguousBindingException must be thrown as appropriate in the case of failing to deduce advice parameter names.
items.translation: 指明在无法推导切面参数名称的情况下，是否应抛出 IllegalArgumentException 和 AspectJAdviceParameterNameDiscoverer.AmbiguousBindingException。

items.source: Specify the factory for objects to be injected into @Resource / @EJB annotated fields and setter methods, for name attributes and default names.
items.translation: 指定要注入到带有 `@Resource` / `@EJB` 注解的字段和 setter 方法的工厂，针对 `name` 属性和默认名称。

items.source: Configure the ResourceUrlProvider that can be used by ResourceTransformer instances.
items.translation: 配置 ResourceUrlProvider，供 ResourceTransformer 实例使用。

items.source: Set the content type of the response to the configured content type unless the View.SELECTED_CONTENT_TYPE request attribute is present and set to a concrete media type.
items.translation: 将响应内容类型设置为配置的 content type，除非存在并设置为具体媒体类型的 View.SELECTED_CONTENT_TYPE 请求属性。

items.source: Set a RowMapper class for this query, creating a fresh RowMapper instance per execution.
items.translation: 为此查询设置一个 RowMapper 类，每次执行时创建一个全新的 RowMapper 实例。

items.source: Configure this handler through an RSocketStrategies instance which can be re-used to initialize a client-side RSocketRequester.
items.translation: 通过一个 `RSocketStrategies` 实例配置此处理器，该实例可被重复使用以初始化客户端侧的 `RSocketRequester`。

items.source: Set the TaskScheduler that will invoke the scheduled methods, or a ScheduledExecutorService to be wrapped as a TaskScheduler.
items.translation: 设置将调用定时方法的 TaskScheduler，或设置一个将被包装为 TaskScheduler 的 ScheduledExecutorService。

items.source: Specify the Quartz Scheduler to operate on via its scheduler name in the Spring application context or also in the Quartz SchedulerRepository.
items.translation: 指定 Quartz Scheduler 在 Spring 应用程序上下文中的调度程序名称进行操作，或者也在 Quartz SchedulerRepository 中。

items.source: Set the service locator interface to use, which must have one or more methods with the signatures MyType xxx() or MyType xxx(MyIdType id) (typically, MyService getService() or MyService getService(String id)).
items.translation: 设置要使用的服务定位器接口，该接口必须包含一个或多个签名如下所示的方法：MyType xxx() 或 MyType xxx(MyIdType id)（通常为 MyService getService() 或 MyService getService(String id)）。

items.source: Set the source of the configuration for this DateFormatter — for example, an instance of the @DateTimeFormat annotation if such an annotation was used to configure this DateFormatter.
items.translation: 设置此DateFormatter的配置源——例如，如果使用了@DateTimeFormat注解来配置此DateFormatter，则可以是该注解的实例。

items.source: Set the SourceExtractor to use for generated bean definitions that correspond to Bean factory methods.
items.translation: 将 `SourceExtractor` 设置为用于与 `Bean` 工厂方法对应的生成的 Bean 定义。

items.source: Set an alternate redirect status code such as HttpStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT or HttpStatus.PERMANENT_REDIRECT.
items.translation: 设置一个替代的重定向状态码，例如 HttpStatus.TEMPORARY_REDIRECT 或 HttpStatus.PERMANENT_REDIRECT。

items.source: Specify whether the Jaxb2Marshaller.supports(Class) returns true for the JAXBElement class.
items.translation: 指定 `Jaxb2Marshaller.supports(Class)` 是否对 `JAXBElement` 类返回 `true`。

items.source: Specify whether JacksonJsonMessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session) should marshal to a BytesMessage or a TextMessage.
items.translation: 指定 `JacksonJsonMessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session)` 应反序列化为 BytesMessage 还是 TextMessage。

items.source: Specify whether MappingJackson2MessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session) should marshal to a BytesMessage or a TextMessage.
items.translation: 指定是否应将MappingJackson2MessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session)反序列化为BytesMessage或TextMessage。

items.source: Specify whether MarshallingMessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session) should marshal to a BytesMessage or a TextMessage.
items.translation: 指定 `MarshallingMessageConverter.toMessage(Object, Session)` 是否应反序列化为 `BytesMessage` 或 `TextMessage`。

items.source: Set the default AsyncTaskExecutor to use when a controller method return a Callable.
items.translation: 将默认的AsyncTaskExecutor设置为当控制器方法返回一个Callable时使用。

items.source: Set XStream type permissions such as AnyTypePermission, ExplicitTypePermission etc, as an alternative to overriding the XStreamMarshaller.customizeXStream(XStream) method.
items.translation: 设置 XStream 类型权限，例如AnyTypePermission、ExplicitTypePermission等，作为覆盖XStreamMarshaller.customizeXStream(XStream)方法的替代方案。

items.source: Set the UriBuilderFactory that will be used to expand the HttpRequestValues.Builder.getUriTemplate().
items.translation: 设置将用于扩展 HttpRequestValues.Builder.getUriTemplate() 的UriBuilderFactory。

items.source: Set an explicit flag for URLConnection.setUseCaches(boolean), to be applied for any URLConnection operation in this resource.
items.translation: 为 `URLConnection.setUseCaches(boolean)` 设置一个显式标志，以便应用于此资源中的任何 `URLConnection` 操作。

items.source: Set the order for the SimpUserRegistry to use as a SmartApplicationListener.
items.translation: 将 `SimpUserRegistry` 的顺序设置为用作 `SmartApplicationListener`。

items.source: Checks if the handler is a HandlerMethod or the resolver has global exception handlers and then delegates to the base class implementation of #shouldApplyTo passing the bean of the HandlerMethod if necessary.
items.translation: 检查处理程序是否为 `HandlerMethod` 或解析器是否具有全局异常处理程序，然后委托给基类中 `#shouldApplyTo` 的实现，并在必要时传递 `HandlerMethod` 的 bean。

items.source: Determine whether to call the AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.beforeRequest(HttpServletRequest, String)/AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.afterRequest(HttpServletRequest, String) methods for the current request, i.e.
items.translation: 确定是否要调用当前请求的 AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.beforeRequest(HttpServletRequest, String)/AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.afterRequest(HttpServletRequest, String) 方法，即

items.source: A handler for messages delegating to @MessageMapping and @SubscribeMapping annotated methods.
items.translation: 用于委托到由 `@MessageMapping` 和 `@SubscribeMapping` 注解的方法的消息处理器。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that creates a new instance of the specified aspect class for every SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现 `AspectInstanceFactory`，为每次调用SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance()创建指定方面类的新实例。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that locates the aspect from the BeanFactory using a configured bean name.
items.translation: 实现 `AspectInstanceFactory`，该接口使用配置的 Bean 名称从`BeanFactory` 定位切面。

items.source: Simple TargetSource implementation, freshly obtaining the specified target bean from its containing Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 简单的TargetSource实现，从包含它的 Spring BeanFactory中获取指定的目标 Bean。

items.source: A "simple" message broker that recognizes the message types defined in SimpMessageType, keeps track of subscriptions with the help of a SubscriptionRegistry, and sends messages to subscribers.
items.translation: 一个“简单”的消息代理，能够识别在 SimpMessageType 中定义的消息类型，借助 SubscriptionRegistry 跟踪订阅，并将消息发送给订阅者。

items.source: Adapter to use the plain Controller workflow interface with the generic DispatcherServlet.
items.translation: 适配器，用于将普通的Controller工作流接口与通用的DispatcherServlet配合使用。

items.source: A simple IdGenerator that starts at 1, increments up to Long.MAX_VALUE, and then rolls over.
items.translation: 一个简单的IdGenerator，从 1 开始递增到Long.MAX_VALUE，然后回绕。

items.source: Constructor that accepts the JDBC DataSource to use when creating the JdbcTemplate.
items.translation: 接受用于创建JdbcTemplate的 JDBC DataSource的构造函数。

items.source: A JmsListenerContainerFactory implementation to build a standard SimpleMessageListenerContainer.
items.translation: 一个 `JmsListenerContainerFactory` 实现，用于构建标准的 `SimpleMessageListenerContainer`。

items.source: Match a String against the given pattern, supporting direct equality as well as the following simple pattern styles: xxx*, *xxx, *xxx*, and xxx*yyy (with an arbitrary number of pattern parts).
items.translation: 将字符串与给定模式进行匹配，支持直接相等以及以下简单模式样式：xxx*、*xxx、*xxx* 和 xxx*yyy（支持任意数量的模式部分）。

items.source: Match a String against the given patterns, supporting direct equality as well as the following simple pattern styles: xxx*, *xxx, *xxx*, and xxx*yyy (with an arbitrary number of pattern parts).
items.translation: 将字符串与给定模式进行匹配，支持直接相等以及以下简单模式样式：xxx*、*xxx、*xxx* 和 xxx*yyy（支持任意数量的模式部分）。

items.source: Implementation of MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory that creates a new instance of the specified aspect class for every SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现 `MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory`，为每次调用`SimpleAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance()` 创建指定 Aspect 类的新实例。

items.source: Simple implementation of the MetadataReaderFactory interface, creating a new ASM ClassReader for every request.
items.translation: `MetadataReaderFactory` 接口的简单实现，为每个请求创建一个新的 ASM ClassReader。

items.source: Simple implementation of the TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext interface, always returning a specified Locale and TimeZone.
items.translation: `TimeZoneAwareLocaleContext` 接口的简单实现，始终返回指定的 `Locale` 和 `TimeZone`。

items.source: A simple transaction-backed Scope implementation, delegating to TransactionSynchronizationManager's resource binding mechanism.
items.translation: 一个简单的由事务支持的 Scope 实现，委托给 TransactionSynchronizationManager 的资源绑定机制。

items.source: A Spring FactoryBean for creating a Quartz SimpleTrigger instance, supporting bean-style usage for trigger configuration.
items.translation: 用于创建 Quartz SimpleTrigger 实例的 Spring FactoryBean，支持以 Bean 方式配置触发器。

items.source: Straightforward implementation of Cache.ValueWrapper, simply holding the value as given at construction and returning it from SimpleValueWrapper.get().
items.translation: 对 `Cache.ValueWrapper` 的简单实现，仅在构造时保存给定值，并从 `SimpleValueWrapper.get()` 返回该值。

items.source: Implementation of DelegatingConnectionFactory that wraps a single R2DBC Connection which is not closed after use.
items.translation: 实现一个 `DelegatingConnectionFactory`，它封装单个 R2DBC Connection，并在使用后不关闭该连接。

items.source: An implementation of ConnectionFactoryLookup that simply wraps a single given ConnectionFactory returned for any connection factory name.
items.translation: 一个实现了 `ConnectionFactoryLookup` 的类，它简单地包装了单个给定的、针对任何连接工厂名称返回的 `ConnectionFactory`。

items.source: Implementation of AspectInstanceFactory that is backed by a specified singleton object, returning the same instance for every SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现由指定单例对象支持的 AspectInstanceFactory，每次调用 SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 时返回相同的实例。

items.source: Implementation of MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory that is backed by a specified singleton object, returning the same instance for every SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() call.
items.translation: 实现由指定单例对象支持的 MetadataAwareAspectInstanceFactory，每次调用 SingletonAspectInstanceFactory.getAspectInstance() 时返回相同的实例。

items.source: Extension of the standard JPA PersistenceUnitInfo interface, for advanced collaboration between Spring's LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean and PersistenceUnitManager implementations.
items.translation: 对标准 JPA PersistenceUnitInfo 接口的扩展，用于实现 Spring 的 LocalContainerEntityManagerFactoryBean 与 PersistenceUnitManager 实现之间的先进协作。

items.source: An HttpRequestHandler that allows mapping a SockJsService to requests in a Servlet container.
items.translation: 一个允许将SockJsService映射到 Servlet 容器中请求的HttpRequestHandler。

items.source: A helper class for configuring SockJS fallback options for use with an EnableWebSocket and WebSocketConfigurer setup.
items.translation: 用于配置 SockJS 回退选项的辅助类，可与 `EnableWebSocket` 和 `WebSocketConfigurer` 配置一起使用。

items.source: Container for the base URL of a SockJS endpoint with additional helper methods to derive related SockJS URLs: specifically, the info and transport URLs.
items.translation: SockJS 端点基本 URL 的容器，并包含用于派生相关 SockJS URL 的辅助方法：具体为 info 和 transport URL。

items.source: An implementation of WebSocketHandler that adds SockJS messages frames, sends SockJS heartbeat messages, and delegates lifecycle events and messages to a target WebSocketHandler.
items.translation: 实现 WebSocketHandler 的类，用于添加 SockJS 消息帧、发送 SockJS 心跳消息，并将生命周期事件和消息委托给目标 WebSocketHandler。

items.source: FactoryBean implementation that takes a list of location Strings and creates a sorted array of Resource instances.
items.translation: FactoryBean 实现，它接收位置字符串列表并创建排序后的 Resource 实例数组。

items.source: Parse the request content as DOMSource and apply the given Matcher.
items.translation: 将请求内容解析为DOMSource，并应用给定的Matcher。

items.source: Parse the response content as DOMSource and apply the given Hamcrest Matcher.
items.translation: 解析响应内容作为DOMSource，并应用给定的 Hamcrest Matcher。

items.source: DynamicFile that holds Java source code and provides SourceFileAssert support.
items.translation: DynamicFile 用于存储 Java 源代码并提供对 SourceFileAssert 的支持。

items.source: ApplicationListener decorator that filters events from a specified event source, invoking its delegate listener for matching ApplicationEvent objects only.
items.translation: ApplicationListener 装饰器用于过滤来自指定事件源的事件，仅对匹配的 ApplicationEvent 对象调用其委托监听器。

items.source: Implementation of HttpMessageConverter that can read and write Source objects.
items.translation: 实现能够读取和写入 Source 对象的HttpMessageConverter。

items.source: Attribute name of the RequestContext instance in the template model, available to Spring's macros — for example, for creating BindStatus objects.
items.translation: 模板模型中 `RequestContext` 实例的属性名称，可供 Spring 宏使用——例如用于创建 BindStatus 对象。

items.source: Spring's implementation of Hibernate's BeanContainer SPI, delegating to a Spring ConfigurableListableBeanFactory.
items.translation: Spring 对 Hibernate 的 `BeanContainer` SPI 的实现，委托给 Spring 的 `ConfigurableListableBeanFactory`。

items.source: @Configuration class that registers an AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect capable of performing dependency injection services for non-Spring managed objects annotated with @Configurable.
items.translation: 注册了 `AnnotationBeanConfigurerAspect` 的 `@Configuration` 类，该切面能够对带有 @Configurable 注解的非 Spring 托管对象执行依赖注入服务。

items.source: Subclass of MutablePersistenceUnitInfo that adds instrumentation hooks based on Spring's LoadTimeWeaver abstraction.
items.translation: 继承自MutablePersistenceUnitInfo的类，它基于 Spring 的LoadTimeWeaver抽象添加了仪器钩子。

items.source: RuntimeHintsRegistrar implementation that registers runtime hints for the SpringPersistenceUnitInfo.
items.translation: RuntimeHintsRegistrar 实现，用于为 SpringPersistenceUnitInfo 注册运行时提示。

items.source: A Spring-provided ServletContainerInitializer designed to support code-based configuration of the servlet container using Spring's WebApplicationInitializer SPI as opposed to (or possibly in combination with) the traditional web.xml-based approach.
items.translation: 由 Spring 提供的 ServletContainerInitializer，旨在支持使用 Spring 的 WebApplicationInitializer SPI 以基于代码的方式配置 servlet 容器，而不是（或可能结合）传统的web.xml方式。

items.source: JSR-303 ConstraintValidatorFactory implementation that delegates to the current Spring WebApplicationContext for creating autowired ConstraintValidator instances.
items.translation: JSR-303 `ConstraintValidatorFactory` 实现，委托给当前的 Spring WebApplicationContext 来创建自动装配的 `ConstraintValidator` 实例。

items.source: Factory for creating SQLErrorCodes based on the "databaseProductName" taken from the DatabaseMetaData.
items.translation: 用于根据从DatabaseMetaData中获取的"databaseProductName"创建基于SQLErrorCodes的工厂。

items.source: SQLExceptionTranslator implementation which analyzes the specific SQLException subclass thrown by the JDBC driver.
items.translation: `SQLExceptionTranslator` 实现，用于分析由 JDBC 驱动程序抛出的特定 `SQLException` 子类。

items.source: Strategy interface for translating between SQLExceptions and Spring's data access strategy-agnostic DataAccessException hierarchy.
items.translation: 用于在SQLExceptions与 Spring 的数据访问策略无关的DataAccessException层次结构之间进行转换的策略接口。

items.source: Class that provides helper methods for the use of SqlParameterSource, in particular with NamedParameterJdbcTemplate.
items.translation: 提供用于使用SqlParameterSource的辅助方法的类，特别是与NamedParameterJdbcTemplate一起使用时。

items.source: Metadata interface for Spring's SqlRowSet, analogous to JDBC's ResultSetMetaData.
items.translation: Spring 的 SqlRowSet 的元数据接口，类似于 JDBC 的 ResultSetMetaData。

items.source: SQLExceptionTranslator implementation that analyzes the SQL state in the SQLException based on the first two digits (the SQL state "class").
items.translation: SQLExceptionTranslator 实现，它根据前两位数字（SQL 状态“类”）分析 SQLException 中的 SQL 状态。

items.source: AnnotationMetadata implementation that uses standard reflection to introspect a given Class.
items.translation: 使用标准反射来内省给定Class的AnnotationMetadata实现。

items.source: BeanInfoFactory implementation that performs standard Introspector inspection.
items.translation: 实现 `BeanInfoFactory` 接口以执行标准的`Introspector` 检查。

items.source: Create a RepeatableContainers instance that searches for repeated annotations according to the semantics of Java's @Repeatable annotation.
items.translation: 创建一个 `RepeatableContainers` 实例，该实例根据 Java 的 @Repeatable 注解的语义来搜索重复的注解。

items.source: Default implementation of the TypeConverter interface, delegating to a core Spring ConversionService.
items.translation: `TypeConverter` 接口的默认实现，委托给核心 Spring `ConversionService`。

items.source: Create a StandardTypeLocator for the default ClassLoader (typically, the thread context ClassLoader).
items.translation: 创建用于默认ClassLoader（通常是线程上下文ClassLoader）的StandardTypeLocator。

items.source: Start concurrent request processing and initialize the given DeferredResult with a DeferredResult.DeferredResultHandler that saves the result and dispatches the request to resume processing of that result.
items.translation: 启动并发请求处理，并使用保存结果并将请求分派以恢复该结果处理的 DeferredResult.DeferredResultHandler 初始化给定的 DeferredResult。

items.source: Abstract adapter class for StompSessionHandler with mostly empty implementation methods except for StompSessionHandlerAdapter.getPayloadType(StompHeaders) which returns String as the default Object type expected for STOMP ERROR frame payloads.
items.translation: `StompSessionHandler` 的抽象适配器类，其实现方法大多为空，除了 StompSessionHandlerAdapter.getPayloadType(StompHeaders) 返回 String，作为 STOMP ERROR 帧负载所期望的默认对象类型。

items.source: Apply the XPath and assert the String value found with the given Hamcrest Matcher.
items.translation: 应用 XPath 并断言使用给定的 Hamcrest Matcher 找到的 String 值。

items.source: Custom PropertyEditor for converting MultipartFiles to Strings.
items.translation: 用于将 MultipartFiles 转换为字符串的自定义 PropertyEditor。

items.source: The DurationFormat.Style to use for parsing and printing a Duration.
items.translation: 用于解析和打印Duration的DurationFormat.Style。

items.source: An overloaded version of StompSession.subscribe(String, StompFrameHandler) with full StompHeaders instead of just a destination.
items.translation: 重载版本的StompSession.subscribe(String, StompFrameHandler)，使用完整的StompHeaders而非仅目的地。

items.source: Overrides SmartApplicationListener.supportsEventType(Class) with delegation to GenericApplicationListener.supportsEventType(ResolvableType).
items.translation: 覆盖SmartApplicationListener.supportsEventType(Class)，并委托给GenericApplicationListener.supportsEventType(ResolvableType)。

items.source: A MethodParameter variant which synthesizes annotations that declare attribute aliases via @AliasFor.
items.translation: 一个 `MethodParameter` 变体，它通过 `@AliasFor` 合成声明属性别名注解。

items.source: Scan the given packageNames and their sub-packages for classes that uses Reflective.
items.translation: 扫描给定的packageNames及其子包，查找使用Reflective的类。

items.source: Create a ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor delegating to the specified ScheduledTaskRegistrar.
items.translation: 创建委托给指定的ScheduledTaskRegistrar的ScheduledAnnotationBeanPostProcessor。

items.source: Interface for an ObservationConvention for scheduled task executions.
items.translation: `ObservationConvention` 接口，用于定时任务执行。

items.source: Documented KeyValues for the observations on executions of scheduled tasks
items.translation: 已记录有关定时任务执行的KeyValues观察结果。

items.source: When used as a type-level annotation in conjunction with @Component, @Scope indicates the name of a scope to use for instances of the annotated type.
items.translation: 当与@Component一起用作类型级注解时，@Scope指示用于已注解类型的实例的 Scope 名称。

items.source: An implementation of the Spring WebFlux ScriptTemplateConfig for creating a ScriptEngine for use in a web application.
items.translation: Spring WebFlux 的 `ScriptTemplateConfig` 实现，用于在 Web 应用程序中创建 `ScriptEngine`。

items.source: An implementation of Spring MVC's ScriptTemplateConfig for creating a ScriptEngine for use in a web application.
items.translation: Spring MVC 的 ScriptTemplateConfig 的实现，用于在 Web 应用程序中创建 ScriptEngine。

items.source: Send a message to the specified destination, converting the payload to a byte[] with the help of a MessageConverter.
items.translation: 向指定的目的地发送消息，借助 MessageConverter 将有效负载转换为 byte[]。
