items.source: Indicates the return value of a message-handling method should be sent as a Message to the specified destination(s) further prepended with "/user/{username}" where the user name is extracted from the headers of the input message being handled.
items.translation: 指示将消息处理方法的返回值作为 `Message` 发送到指定的目的地，并进一步在路径前添加 `"/user/{username}"`，其中用户名是从正在处理的输入消息的头部中提取的。

items.source: Create a SerializingConverter that delegates to the provided Serializer.
items.translation: 创建一个委托给提供的Serializer的SerializingConverter。

items.source: Create a new ServerEndpointRegistration instance from an jakarta.websocket.Endpoint instance.
items.translation: 从 `jakarta.websocket.Endpoint` 实例创建一个新的 ServerEndpointRegistration 实例。

items.source: Create a new ServerEndpointRegistration instance from an jakarta.websocket.Endpoint class.
items.translation: 创建一个 ServerEndpointRegistration 实例，其来源为 jakarta.websocket.Endpoint 类。

items.source: Interface for an ObservationConvention for Servlet HTTP requests.
items.translation: 用于Servlet HTTP 请求的ObservationConvention接口。

items.source: Interface for an ObservationConvention for reactive HTTP requests.
items.translation: 用于响应式 HTTP 请求的ObservationConvention接口。

items.source: Implementation of the Headers interface that can be subclassed to adapt the headers in a handler filter function.
items.translation: 可被继承以适配 处理器过滤器函数 中请求头的 `Headers` 接口的实现。

items.source: HandlerResultHandler implementation that supports ServerResponses.
items.translation: 支持ServerResponses的HandlerResultHandler实现。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ServletConfig (typically determined by the WebApplicationContext) that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的ServletConfig（通常由WebApplicationContext确定）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: PropertySource that reads init parameters from a ServletConfig object.
items.translation: 读取 `ServletConfig` 对象中的初始化参数的 `PropertySource`。

items.source: Interface to be implemented by any object that wishes to be notified of the ServletContext (typically determined by the WebApplicationContext) that it runs in.
items.translation: 任何希望接收其运行的 ServletContext（通常由 WebApplicationContext 确定）通知的对象都必须实现的接口。

items.source: FactoryBean that retrieves a specific ServletContext init parameter (that is, a "context-param" defined in web.xml).
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于获取特定的 ServletContext 初始化参数（即在web.xml中定义的"context-param"）。

items.source: PropertySource that reads init parameters from a ServletContext object.
items.translation: PropertySource 用于从 ServletContext 对象读取初始化参数。

items.source: Resource implementation for ServletContext resources, interpreting relative paths within the web application root directory.
items.translation: `Resource` 接口的实现，用于 `ServletContext` 资源，并解释相对于 Web 应用程序根目录的路径。

items.source: ServletContext-aware subclass of PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver, able to find matching resources below the web application root directory via ServletContext.getResourcePaths(String).
items.translation: `ServletContext` 感知的 `PathMatchingResourcePatternResolver` 子类，能够通过 ServletContext.getResourcePaths(String) 在 Web 应用程序根目录下方查找匹配的资源。

items.source: An AbstractCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver that resolves cookie values from an HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 一个从HttpServletRequest解析 Cookie 值的AbstractCookieValueMethodArgumentResolver。

items.source: Adapt HttpHandler to an HttpServlet using Servlet Async support and Servlet non-blocking I/O.
items.translation: 将 `HttpHandler` 适配为使用 Servlet 异步支持和 Servlet 非阻塞 I/O 的 `HttpServlet`。

items.source: A FactoryBean for configuring ServerContainer.
items.translation: 用于配置ServerContainer的FactoryBean。

items.source: ServerHttpRequest implementation that is based on a HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: 基于 `HttpServletRequest` 的 `ServerHttpRequest` 实现。

items.source: ServerHttpResponse implementation that is based on a HttpServletResponse.
items.translation: 基于 `HttpServletResponse` 的 `ServerHttpResponse` 实现。

items.source: WebRequest adapter for an HttpServletRequest.
items.translation: `WebRequest` 适配器用于 `HttpServletRequest`。

items.source: LocaleResolver implementation that uses a locale attribute in the user's session in case of a custom setting, with a fallback to the configured default locale, the request's Accept-Language header, or the default locale for the server.
items.translation: LocaleResolver 实现，在自定义设置的情况下使用用户会话中的区域设置属性，并回退到配置的区域设置、请求的Accept-Language 头或服务器的默认区域设置。

items.source: @SessionScope is a specialization of @Scope for a component whose lifecycle is bound to the current web session.
items.translation: @SessionScope 是 @Scope 的一个特化版本，用于生命周期绑定到当前 Web 会话的组件。

items.source: Set the list of acceptable media types for PATCH methods, as specified by the Accept-Patch header.
items.translation: 设置 PATCH 方法的可接受媒体类型列表，由 Accept-Patch 标头指定。

items.source: Whether to adapt ConstraintViolations to MethodValidationResult.
items.translation: 是否将 `ConstraintViolation` 适配为 MethodValidationResult。

items.source: Specify the XmlAdapters to be registered with the JAXB Marshaller and Unmarshaller.
items.translation: 指定要注册到 JAXB Marshaller 和 Unmarshaller 的 XmlAdapter。

items.source: Set the set of allowed HTTP methods, as specified by the Allow header.
items.translation: 设置允许的HTTP 方法集合，由Allow标头指定。

items.source: Set the HTTP methods to allow, for example, "GET", "POST", "PUT", etc.
items.translation: 设置允许使用的 HTTP 方法，例如 `"GET"`、`"POST"`、`"PUT"` 等。

items.source: A list of origins for which cross-origin requests are allowed where each value may be one of the following: a specific domain, for example, "https://domain1.com" comma-delimited list of specific domains, for example, "https://a1.com,https://a2.com"; this is convenient when a value is resolved through a property placeholder, for example, "${origin}"; note that such placeholders must be resolved externally.
items.translation: 允许跨域请求的源列表，其中每个值可以是以下之一： 特定域名，例如 `"https://domain1.com"`； 逗号分隔的特定域名列表，例如 `"https://a1.com,https://a2.com"`；当值通过属性占位符解析时，此格式非常方便，例如 `"${origin}"`；请注意，此类占位符必须在外部进行解析。

items.source: A ConfigurableApplicationContext is expected for resolving expressions in method argument default values as well as for detecting @ControllerAdvice beans.
items.translation: 预期使用ConfigurableApplicationContext来解析方法参数默认值中的表达式，以及检测@ControllerAdvice bean。

items.source: Configure the ApplicationContext associated with the web application, if it was initialized with one via WebHttpHandlerBuilder.applicationContext(ApplicationContext).
items.translation: 配置与 Web 应用程序关联的ApplicationContext，如果它已通过WebHttpHandlerBuilder.applicationContext(ApplicationContext)进行初始化。

items.source: Set the BeanFactory to use to resolve expressions (may be null).
items.translation: 将 `BeanFactory` 设置为用于解析表达式（可为 `null`）。

items.source: Set a configured CacheControl instance as the new value of the Cache-Control header.
items.translation: 将配置的CacheControl实例设置为Cache-Control标头的新值。

items.source: Set the CaffeineSpec to use for building each individual CaffeineCache instance.
items.translation: 设置用于构建每个单独的 CaffeineCache 实例的 CaffeineSpec。

items.source: Specify whether the Jaxb2Marshaller.supports(Class) should check for @XmlRootElement annotations.
items.translation: 指定是否应检查 `Jaxb2Marshaller.supports(Class)` 是否存在`@XmlRootElement` 注解。

items.source: Set the processed annotated classes, effectively overriding the original value declared via @ContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 设置 `processed` 注解类，从而覆盖通过 `@ContextConfiguration` 声明的原始值。

items.source: Configure the Clock to use to set the lastAccessTime on every created session and to calculate if the session has expired.
items.translation: 配置要用于在每次创建的会话上设置lastAccessTime并计算会话是否过期的Clock。

items.source: Set whether the proxy should connect to the MBeanServer at creation time (true) or the first time it is invoked (false).
items.translation: 设置代理是在创建时（`true`）还是首次调用时连接到 `<MBeanServer>`（`false`）。

items.source: Set the name of the ServletContext attribute which should be used to retrieve the WebApplicationContext from which to load the delegate Filter bean.
items.translation: 设置用于从其中加载委托 `Filter` Bean 的 `WebApplicationContext` 的 ServletContext 属性名称。 WebApplicationContext

items.source: Specify which ApplicationContextInitializer instances should be used to initialize the application context used by this ContextLoader.
items.translation: 指定要用于初始化此 `ContextLoader` 使用的应用上下文的哪些 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 实例。

items.source: Specify which ApplicationContextInitializer instances should be used to initialize the application context used by this FrameworkServlet.
items.translation: 指定应使用哪些 `ApplicationContextInitializer` 实例来初始化此 `FrameworkServlet` 使用的应用程序上下文。

items.source: Register one or more ControllerAdvice instances to be used in tests (specified Class will be turned into instance).
items.translation: 注册一个或多个将在测试中使用的 `ControllerAdvice` 实例（指定的 `Class` 将被转换为实例）。

items.source: Set a ConversionService for binding JDBC values to bean properties, or null for none.
items.translation: 设置一个用于将 JDBC 值绑定到 Bean 属性的ConversionService，或者设置为null表示不使用。

items.source: Set the Converters or SingleValueConverters to be registered with the XStream instance.
items.translation: 将 `Converters` 或 `SingleValueConverters` 注册到 `XStream` 实例。

items.source: Set the configurer to use to configure the embedded database, as an alternative to EmbeddedDatabaseBuilder.setType(EmbeddedDatabaseType).
items.translation: 将configurer设置为用于配置嵌入式数据库的替代方案，而不是使用EmbeddedDatabaseBuilder.setType(EmbeddedDatabaseType)。

items.source: Set the Charset for the default encoding for the FreeMarker Configuration, which is used to decode byte sequences to character sequences when reading template files.
items.translation: 为 FreeMarker `Configuration` 设置默认编码的Charset，该配置在读取模板文件时将字节序列解码为字符序列。

items.source: Set the default domain to be used by the MBeanServer, to be passed to MBeanServerFactory.createMBeanServer() or MBeanServerFactory.findMBeanServer().
items.translation: 设置默认域，供 `MBeanServer` 使用，并传递给 `MBeanServerFactory.createMBeanServer()` 或 `MBeanServerFactory.findMBeanServer()`。

items.source: Set the default transaction isolation level by the name of the corresponding constant in Connection — for example, "TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE".
items.translation: 通过设置与 Connection 中相应常量的名称来指定默认事务隔离级别——例如，"TRANSACTION_SERIALIZABLE"。

items.source: Set the DestinationResolver that is to be used to resolve Destination references for this accessor.
items.translation: 设置要用于解析此访问器中 `Destination` 引用的 DestinationResolver。

items.source: Configure the DestinationResolver to use to resolve String destination names into actual destinations of type <D>.
items.translation: 配置用于将 String 类型目的地名称解析为实际 `` 类型目的地的DestinationResolver。

items.source: Whether to enable the automatic addition of the MessageHeaders.TIMESTAMP header on MessageHeaderAccessor instances being initialized.
items.translation: 是否要在初始化`MessageHeaderAccessor`实例时启用自动添加MessageHeaders.TIMESTAMP标头。

items.source: Set the Environment to use when evaluating whether @Conditional-annotated component classes should be registered.
items.translation: 设置用于评估是否应注册带有 @Conditional 注解的组件类的 Environment。

items.source: Set the ErrorHandler to be invoked in case of any uncaught exceptions thrown while processing a Message.
items.translation: 设置 `ErrorHandler`，以便在处理 `Message` 时发生任何未捕获的异常时被调用。

items.source: Set the escape character to use to ignore the placeholder prefix and the value separator, or null if no escaping should take place.
items.translation: 设置用于忽略占位符前缀和值分隔符的转义字符，或者如果不需要转义则设置为`null`。

items.source: Supply the AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler to use to handle exceptions thrown by invoking asynchronous methods with a void return type.
items.translation: 提供 `AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler` 来处理调用返回类型为 `void` 的异步方法时抛出的异常。

items.source: Set whether to expose a RequestContext for use by Spring's macro library, under the name "springMacroRequestContext".
items.translation: 设置是否暴露一个 `RequestContext` 供 Spring 的宏库使用，名称为 `"springMacroRequestContext"`。

items.source: Set the field represented by the supplied field object on the specified target object to the specified value.
items.translation: 将指定的 `value` 设置到由提供的field object表示的字段上，该字段位于指定的target object上。

items.source: Set the InvocableHandlerMethod to use to invoke the method processing an incoming Message.
items.translation: 将 `InvocableHandlerMethod` 设置为用于调用处理传入的 `Message` 的方法。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages created through the SimpMessagingTemplate.
items.translation: 配置一个 `MessageHeaderInitializer` 以应用于通过 `SimpMessagingTemplate` 创建的所有消息的标头。

items.source: Configure a MessageHeaderInitializer to apply to the headers of all messages created through the StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler that are sent to the client outbound message channel.
items.translation: 配置一个MessageHeaderInitializer，使其适用于通过StompBrokerRelayMessageHandler创建并发送到客户端出站消息通道的所有消息的标头。

items.source: Configure a predicate for selecting which headers should be logged if AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.setIncludeHeaders(boolean) is set to true.
items.translation: 配置一个谓词，用于选择要记录的标头；如果将AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.setIncludeHeaders(boolean)设置为true。

items.source: Set the default isolation level by the name of the corresponding constant in TransactionDefinition — for example, "ISOLATION_SERIALIZABLE".
items.translation: 通过设置与TransactionDefinition中相应常量的名称来指定默认隔离级别——例如，"ISOLATION_SERIALIZABLE"。

items.source: Set the isolation level by the name of the corresponding constant in TransactionDefinition — for example, "ISOLATION_DEFAULT".
items.translation: 通过设置与相应常量名称匹配的隔离级别来指定它，例如 `TransactionDefinition` 中的 `"ISOLATION_DEFAULT"`。

items.source: Set the Spring JtaTransactionManager or the JTA TransactionManager to be used with Hibernate, if any.
items.translation: 设置要与 Hibernate 一起使用的 Spring JtaTransactionManager 或 JTA TransactionManager（如果有）。

items.source: Set the Spring JtaTransactionManager or the JTA TransactionManager to be used with Hibernate, if any.
items.translation: 设置要与 Hibernate 一起使用的 Spring JtaTransactionManager 或 JTA TransactionManager（如果有）。

items.source: Specify the name of the corresponding attribute in the HttpSession, holding the current Locale value.
items.translation: 指定 `HttpSession` 中用于存储当前 Locale 值的相应属性名称。

items.source: Set the processed resource locations, effectively overriding the original value declared via @ContextConfiguration.
items.translation: 设置 `processed` 资源位置，从而覆盖通过 @ContextConfiguration 声明的原始值。

items.source: Set the ManagedClassNameFilter to apply on entity classes discovered using classpath scanning.
items.translation: 将 `ManagedClassNameFilter` 设置为应用于通过 类路径扫描 发现的实体类。

items.source: Set the ManagedClassNameFilter to apply on entity classes discovered using classpath scanning.
items.translation: 将 `ManagedClassNameFilter` 设置为应用于通过 类路径扫描 发现的实体类。

items.source: Set the MessageConverter to use in convertAndSend methods.
items.translation: 将 `MessageConverter` 设置为在 `convertAndSend` 方法中使用。

items.source: Set the MessageConverter to use to convert the payload of incoming and outgoing messages to and from byte[] based on object type, or expected object type, and the "content-type" header.
items.translation: 设置MessageConverter，用于根据对象类型或预期对象类型以及"content-type"标头，将传入和传出消息的有效负载转换为byte[]。

items.source: Set the MessageConverter to use to convert the payload of incoming and outgoing messages to and from byte[] based on object type and the "content-type" header.
items.translation: 将 `MessageConverter` 设置为用于根据对象类型和"content-type"标头，将传入和传出消息的负载转换为 `byte[]`。

items.source: Set the DataSource to be used for non-transactional access.
items.translation: 将 `DataSource` 设置为用于非事务性访问。

items.source: Set the ObjectName of the MBean which calls are routed to, as ObjectName instance or as String.
items.translation: 将调用路由到的 MBean 的 `ObjectName` 设置为 `ObjectName` 实例或 `String`。

items.source: Configure a resolver to determine the name of an @Valid method parameter to use for its BindingResult.
items.translation: 配置一个解析器，以确定用于其BindingResult的@Valid方法参数的名称。

items.source: Set the ParameterNameDiscoverer to discover method parameter names with to create error codes for MessageSourceResolvable.
items.translation: 将 `ParameterNameDiscoverer` 设置为发现方法参数名称，以便为 MessageSourceResolvable 创建错误代码。

items.source: Set the propagation behavior by the name of the corresponding constant in TransactionDefinition — for example, "PROPAGATION_REQUIRED".
items.translation: 通过设置对应常量的名称来配置传播行为，例如 `TransactionDefinition` 中的 `"PROPAGATION_REQUIRED"`。

items.source: Configure a predicate for selecting which query parameters should be logged if AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.setIncludeQueryString(boolean) is set to true.
items.translation: 配置一个谓词，用于选择应记录哪些查询参数；如果已设置AbstractRequestLoggingFilter.setIncludeQueryString(boolean)为true。

items.source: Set whether to register the MBeanServer with the MBeanServerFactory, making it available through MBeanServerFactory.findMBeanServer().
items.translation: 设置是否将 `MBeanServer` 注册到 `MBeanServerFactory`，使其可通过 `MBeanServerFactory.findMBeanServer()` 访问。

items.source: Add one or more RequestBodyAdvice instances to intercept the request before it is read and converted for @RequestBody and HttpEntity method arguments.
items.translation: 添加一个或多个 `RequestBodyAdvice` 实例以拦截请求，在将其读取并转换为 `@RequestBody` 和 `HttpEntity` 方法参数之前进行处理。

items.source: Add one or more components to be invoked after the execution of a controller method annotated with @ResponseBody or returning ResponseEntity but before the body is written to the response with the selected HttpMessageConverter.
items.translation: 在添加了带有 `@ResponseBody` 注解或返回 `ResponseEntity` 的控制器方法执行后，但在使用选定的 `HttpMessageConverter` 将正文写入响应之前，添加一个或多个要调用的组件。

items.source: Add one or more ResponseBodyAdvice instances to intercept the response before @ResponseBody or ResponseEntity return values are written to the response body.
items.translation: 添加一个或多个 ResponseBodyAdvice 实例以拦截响应，在 @ResponseBody 或 ResponseEntity 返回值写入响应体之前进行处理。

items.source: When set to false, a new ScriptEngine instance will be created for each request, else the same instance will be reused.
items.translation: 当设置为 `false` 时，将为每个请求创建一个新的 ScriptEngine 实例；否则将重用相同的实例。

items.source: When set to false, use thread-local ScriptEngine instances instead of one single shared instance.
items.translation: 当设置为 `false` 时，使用线程本地的 ScriptEngine 实例，而不是单个共享实例。

items.source: Set the SSLContext to use for ClientEndpointConfig.getSSLContext().
items.translation: 将 `SSLContext` 设置为用于 `ClientEndpointConfig.getSSLContext()`。

items.source: Set whether the returned Connection should be a close-suppressing proxy or the physical Connection.
items.translation: 设置返回的Connection应为抑制关闭的代理还是物理Connection。

items.source: Specify the name of the corresponding attribute in the HttpSession, holding the current TimeZone value.
items.translation: 指定 `HttpSession` 中用于存储当前 TimeZone 值的相应属性名称。

items.source: Setter for a Map of SQLExceptionTranslator references where the key must be the database name as defined in the sql-error-codes.xml file.
items.translation: Setter for a Map of SQLExceptionTranslator references where the key must be the database name as defined in the sql-error-codes.xml file.

items.source: Set whether we should look at the Resource.lastModified() when serving resources and use this information to drive "Last-Modified" HTTP response headers.
items.translation: 设置是否在提供资源时查看Resource.lastModified()，并使用此信息来驱动"Last-Modified"HTTP 响应头。

items.source: Set whether we should look at the Resource.lastModified() when serving resources and use this information to drive "Last-Modified" HTTP response headers.
items.translation: 设置是否在提供资源时查看Resource.lastModified()，并使用此信息来驱动"Last-Modified"HTTP 响应头。

items.source: Whether the Accept-Charset header should be written to any outgoing request sourced from the value of Charset.availableCharsets().
items.translation: 是否应将 `Accept-Charset` 头写入任何源自 `Charset.availableCharsets()` 值的传出请求。

items.source: Create a new instance of ShardingKeyDataSourceAdapter, wrapping the given DataSource.
items.translation: 创建一个新的ShardingKeyDataSourceAdapter实例，包装给定的DataSource。

items.source: FactoryBean that exposes a shared JPA EntityManager reference for a given EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: FactoryBean 用于暴露给定 EntityManagerFactory 的共享 JPA EntityManager 引用。

items.source: MockMvcConfigurer that stores and re-uses the HTTP session across multiple requests performed through the same MockMvc instance.
items.translation: MockMvcConfigurer 用于存储并在通过同一 MockMvc 实例执行的多个请求之间重用 HTTP 会话。

items.source: Construct a new SimpleCacheResolver for the given CacheManager.
items.translation: 为给定的CacheManager构建一个新的SimpleCacheResolver。

items.source: CommandLinePropertySource implementation backed by an instance of CommandLineArgs.
items.translation: 由 CommandLineArgs 实例支持的CommandLinePropertySource实现。

items.source: A JmsListenerEndpoint simply providing the MessageListener to invoke to process an incoming message for this endpoint.
items.translation: 一个 `JmsListenerEndpoint` 仅提供要调用的 `MessageListener`，以处理该端点的传入消息。

items.source: LoadTimeWeaver that builds and exposes a SimpleInstrumentableClassLoader.
items.translation: LoadTimeWeaver 构建并暴露一个 SimpleInstrumentableClassLoader。

items.source: Simple implementation of the LocaleContext interface, always returning a specified Locale.
items.translation: `LocaleContext` 接口的简单实现，始终返回指定的 `Locale`。

items.source: Create a new SimpleLocaleContext that exposes the specified Locale.
items.translation: 创建一个新的 `SimpleLocaleContext` 以暴露指定的 Locale。

items.source: Create a SimpleRetryInterceptor for the given MethodRetrySpec.
items.translation: 为给定的MethodRetrySpec创建一个SimpleRetryInterceptor。

items.source: RouteMatcher that delegates to a PathMatcher.
items.translation: 委托给PathMatcher的RouteMatcher。

items.source: Create a new SimpleRouteMatcher for the given PathMatcher delegate.
items.translation: 为给定的 `PathMatcher` 委托创建一个新的 `SimpleRouteMatcher`。

items.source: BeanPostProcessor that applies initialization and destruction callbacks to beans that implement the Servlet interface.
items.translation: BeanPostProcessor 会对实现 Servlet 接口的 bean 应用初始化和销毁回调。

items.source: Simple implementation of the SessionStatus interface, keeping the complete flag as an instance variable.
items.translation: `SessionStatus` 接口的简单实现，将 `complete` 标志作为实例变量保留。

items.source: Default implementation of the TransactionFactory strategy interface, simply wrapping a standard JTA TransactionManager.
items.translation: `TransactionFactory` 策略接口的默认实现，简单地包装了标准的 JTA `TransactionManager`。

items.source: ValueStyler that converts objects to String form — generally for debugging purposes — using simple styling conventions that mimic the toString() styling conventions for standard JDK implementations of collections, maps, and arrays.
items.translation: 将对象转换为字符串形式的ValueStyler——通常用于调试目的——使用简单的样式约定，模仿标准 JDK 实现中集合、映射和数组的toString()样式约定。

items.source: MessageCondition that matches by the message type obtained via SimpMessageHeaderAccessor.getMessageType(Map).
items.translation: 通过 `SimpMessageHeaderAccessor.getMessageType(Map)` 获取的消息类型进行匹配的`MessageCondition`。

items.source: Return an Validator instance for validating @Payload method arguments.
items.translation: 返回一个用于验证 `@Payload` 方法参数的`Validator` 实例。

items.source: A JMS ConnectionFactory adapter that returns the same Connection from all SingleConnectionFactory.createConnection() calls, and ignores calls to Connection.close().
items.translation: 一个 JMS ConnectionFactory 适配器，它从所有 SingleConnectionFactory.createConnection() 调用中返回相同的 Connection，并忽略对Connection.close()的调用。

items.source: Skip buffers from the given Publisher until the total byte count reaches the given maximum byte count, or until the publisher is complete.
items.translation: 从给定的 Publisher 跳过缓冲区，直到总字节数达到给定的最大字节数，或者直到发布者完成。

items.source: An extension of the Lifecycle interface for those objects that require to be started upon ApplicationContext refresh and/or shutdown in a particular order.
items.translation: 一个扩展了Lifecycle接口的接口，用于那些需要在ApplicationContext刷新和/或关闭时按特定顺序启动的对象。

items.source: Obtain a Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder instance in order to build a Smile data format ObjectMapper instance.
items.translation: 获取一个Jackson2ObjectMapperBuilder实例，以便构建一个 Smile 数据格式的ObjectMapper实例。

items.source: Uses a StompEncoder to encode a message and splits it into parts no larger than the configured buffer size limit.
items.translation: 使用 `StompEncoder` 对消息进行编码，并将其拆分为不超过配置的缓冲区大小限制的部分。

items.source: @SpringExtensionConfig is a type-level annotation that can be used to configure the behavior of the SpringExtension.
items.translation: @SpringExtensionConfig 是一个类型级别的注解，可用于配置 SpringExtension 的行为。

items.source: Construct a new SpringFailOnTimeout statement for the supplied testMethod, retrieving the configured timeout from the @Timed annotation on the supplied method.
items.translation: 为提供的 `testMethod` 构建一个新的 `SpringFailOnTimeout` 语句，从提供的方法上的 `@Timed` 注解中获取配置的超时时间。

items.source: Adapter that implements the JTA Synchronization interface delegating to an underlying Spring TransactionSynchronization.
items.translation: 实现 JTA `Synchronization` 接口并委托给底层 Spring `TransactionSynchronization` 的适配器。

items.source: Construct a new SpringJUnit4ClassRunner and initialize a TestContextManager to provide Spring testing functionality to standard JUnit tests.
items.translation: 构建一个新的 SpringJUnit4ClassRunner 并初始化一个 TestContextManager，为标准 JUnit 测试提供 Spring 测试功能。

items.source: Construct a new SpringRepeat statement for the supplied testMethod, retrieving the configured repeat count from the @Repeat annotation on the supplied method.
items.translation: 为提供的 `testMethod` 构建一个新的 `SpringRepeat` 语句，从提供的方法上的 `@Repeat` 注解中获取配置的重复次数。

items.source: Construct a new SpringRepeat statement for the supplied testMethod and repeat count.
items.translation: 为提供的 `testMethod` 和 `repeat` 计数构建一个新的 `SpringRepeat` 语句。

items.source: Construct a new SpringRunner and initialize a TestContextManager to provide Spring testing functionality to standard JUnit 4 tests.
items.translation: 构建一个新的SpringRunner并初始化一个TestContextManager，为标准 JUnit 4 测试提供 Spring 测试功能。

items.source: FreeMarker TemplateLoader adapter that loads template files via a Spring ResourceLoader.
items.translation: 加载模板文件的 FreeMarker TemplateLoader 适配器，通过 Spring ResourceLoader 实现。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to call 'after test class' callbacks.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager 以调用'after test class'回调。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to post-process the test method after the actual test has executed.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager，在测试方法实际执行后对其进行后处理。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to call 'before test class' callbacks.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager 以调用'before test class'回调。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to pre-process the test method before the actual test is executed.
items.translation: 委托给配置的 TestContextManager 来在测试方法实际执行之前预处理该测试方法。

items.source: Delegates to the configured TestContextManager to prepare this test instance prior to execution of any individual tests, for example for injecting dependencies, etc.
items.translation: 委托给已配置的 TestContextManager，在执行任何单个测试之前准备此测试实例，例如用于注入依赖项等。

items.source: Adapter that takes a JSR-303 javax.validator.Validator and exposes it as a Spring Validator while also exposing the original JSR-303 Validator interface itself.
items.translation: 适配器接收一个 JSR-303 javax.validator.Validator，并将其暴露为 Spring Validator，同时也暴露原始的 JSR-303 Validator 接口本身。

items.source: @SqlConfig defines metadata that is used to determine how to parse and execute SQL scripts configured via the @Sql annotation.
items.translation: @SqlConfig 定义了元数据，用于确定如何解析和执行通过 @Sql 注解配置的 SQL 脚本。

items.source: DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer that increments the maximum value of a given table with the equivalent of an auto-increment column, using a SQLite select max(rowid) query.
items.translation: DataFieldMaxValueIncrementer 使用 SQLite select max(rowid) 查询，以自增列等效方式递增给定表的最大值。

items.source: A specialization of ResponseBodyEmitter for sending Server-Sent Events.
items.translation: `ResponseBodyEmitter` 的专用类，用于发送 服务器发送事件 (Server-Sent Events)。

items.source: Build a MockMvc instance by registering one or more @Controller instances and configuring Spring MVC infrastructure programmatically.
items.translation: 通过注册一个或多个 `@Controller` 实例并编程方式配置 Spring MVC 基础设施来构建一个 `MockMvc` 实例。

items.source: ApiVersionDeprecationHandler based on RFC 9745 and RFC 8594 that provides the option to set the "Deprecation" and "Sunset" response headers, as well as to add "Link" headers with further details about both.
items.translation: ApiVersionDeprecationHandler 基于RFC 9745和RFC 8594，提供设置“Deprecation”和“Sunset”响应头选项的功能，并可添加包含两者进一步详情的“Link”头。

items.source: ClassMetadata implementation that uses standard reflection to introspect a given Class.
items.translation: 使用标准反射来内省给定 `Class` 的 `ClassMetadata` 实现。

items.source: Create a new StandardEnvironment instance with a default MutablePropertySources instance.
items.translation: 创建一个新的带有默认MutablePropertySources实例的StandardEnvironment对象。

items.source: Create a new StandardEnvironment instance with a specific MutablePropertySources instance.
items.translation: 创建一个带有特定MutablePropertySources实例的新的StandardEnvironment实例。

items.source: MethodMetadata implementation that uses standard reflection to introspect a given Method.
items.translation: 使用标准反射来内省给定Method的MethodMetadata实现。

items.source: javax.script (JSR-223) based implementation of Spring's ScriptEvaluator strategy interface.
items.translation: javax.script (JSR-223) 实现的 Spring ScriptEvaluator 策略接口。

items.source: Construct a new StandardScriptEvaluator for the given JSR-223 ScriptEngineManager to obtain script engines from.
items.translation: 为给定的 JSR-223 ScriptEngineManager 构造一个新的 StandardScriptEvaluator，用于从中获取脚本引擎。

items.source: Environment implementation to be used by Servlet-based web applications.
items.translation: 用于基于 `Servlet` 的 Web 应用程序的Environment实现。

items.source: Create a new StandardServletEnvironment instance with a specific MutablePropertySources instance.
items.translation: 创建一个具有特定MutablePropertySources实例的新的StandardServletEnvironment实例。

items.source: Standard implementation of the MultipartResolver interface, based on the Servlet Part API.
items.translation: `MultipartResolver` 接口的标准实现，基于 Servlet `Part` API。

items.source: A subclass of WebSocketExtension that can be constructed from a Extension.
items.translation: 一个可以从 `Extension` 构造的 `WebSocketExtension` 的子类。

items.source: Create a StandardTypeLocator for the given ClassLoader.
items.translation: 为给定的ClassLoader创建一个StandardTypeLocator。

items.source: Spring WebSocketSession adapter for a standard Java (JSR 356) Session.
items.translation: Spring WebSocketSession 适配器用于标准的 Java (JSR 356) Session。

items.source: Start all registered beans that implement Lifecycle and are not already running.
items.translation: 启动所有已注册的、实现Lifecycle且尚未运行的Bean。

items.source: Create a regular StaticListableBeanFactory, to be populated with singleton bean instances through StaticListableBeanFactory.addBean(String, Object) calls.
items.translation: 创建一个普通的StaticListableBeanFactory，并通过StaticListableBeanFactory.addBean(String, Object)调用填充单例 Bean 实例。

items.source: HTTP response raw status code, or "IO_ERROR" in case of IOException, or "CLIENT_ERROR" if no response was received.
items.translation: HTTP 响应原始状态码，或在发生 `IOException` 时为 `"IO_ERROR"`，或未收到响应时为 `"CLIENT_ERROR"`。

items.source: Stop all registered beans that implement Lifecycle and are currently running.
items.translation: 停止所有已注册的、实现Lifecycle且当前正在运行的 Bean。

items.source: Supports return values of type StreamingResponseBody and also ResponseEntity<StreamingResponseBody>.
items.translation: 支持返回类型为StreamingResponseBody以及ResponseEntity<StreamingResponseBody>的值。

items.source: Whether the given method parameter is supported by any registered HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.
items.translation: 给定的方法参数是否由任何已注册的HandlerMethodArgumentResolver支持。

items.source: Whether the given method parameter is supported by any registered HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.
items.translation: 给定的方法参数是否由任何已注册的HandlerMethodArgumentResolver支持。

items.translation: 如果参数已用 ModelAttribute 注解，或者在默认解析模式下对于任何非简单类型的参数，则返回 true。

items.source: Whether the given method parameter is supported by any registered HandlerMethodArgumentResolver.
items.translation: 给定的方法参数是否由任何已注册的HandlerMethodArgumentResolver支持。

items.source: Whether the given method return type is supported by any registered HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler.
items.translation: 给定方法返回类型是否由任何已注册的HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler支持。

items.source: TaskExecutor implementation that executes each task synchronously in the calling thread.
items.translation: TaskExecutor 实现，在调用线程中同步执行每个任务。

items.source: Specialization of MapPropertySource designed for use with system environment variables.
items.translation: 专为与系统环境变量一起使用而设计的 MapPropertySource 特化类。

items.source: as of 6.0, in favor of TaskScheduler.schedule(Runnable, Instant)
items.translation: 自 6.0 版本起，推荐使用 `TaskScheduler.schedule(Runnable, Instant)`。

items.source: as of 6.0, in favor of TaskScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(Runnable, Duration)
items.translation: 自 6.0 版本起，推荐使用 TaskScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(Runnable, Duration)

items.source: as of 6.0, in favor of TaskScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(Runnable, Instant, Duration)
items.translation: 自 6.0 版本起，推荐使用 TaskScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(Runnable, Instant, Duration)

items.source: as of 6.0, in favor of TaskScheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(Runnable, Duration)
items.translation: 自 6.0 版本起，推荐使用 TaskScheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(Runnable, Duration)

items.source: as of 6.0, in favor of TaskScheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(Runnable, Instant, Duration)
items.translation: 自 6.0 版本起，推荐使用 TaskScheduler.scheduleWithFixedDelay(Runnable, Instant, Duration)

items.source: as of 6.1, in favor of the "autodetect" flag
items.translation: 自 6.1 版本起，推荐使用"autodetect" flag。

items.source: as of 6.0, in favor of PeriodicTrigger.setInitialDelay(Duration)
items.translation: 自 6.0 版本起，推荐使用PeriodicTrigger.setInitialDelay(Duration)。

items.source: in favor of MethodParameter.withTypeIndex(int)
items.translation: 支持使用MethodParameter.withTypeIndex(int)。

items.source: as of 6.0, in favor of SimpleTriggerContext(Instant, Instant, Instant)
items.translation: 自 6.0 版本起，推荐使用 SimpleTriggerContext(Instant, Instant, Instant)

items.source: in favor of ConcurrentLruCache.capacity() as of 6.0.
items.translation: 支持自 6.0 版本起使用的ConcurrentLruCache.capacity()。

items.source: since 7.0 in favor of JacksonHandlerInstantiator
items.translation: 自 7.0 版本起，推荐使用JacksonHandlerInstantiator。

items.source: as of 5.3.29, in favor of SQLWarningException.getSQLWarning()
items.translation: 自 5.3.29 版本起，推荐使用SQLWarningException.getSQLWarning()。

items.source: as of 6.2, in favor of a direct SqlValue implementation
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，更倾向于直接使用 `SqlValue` 实现。

items.source: in favor of the factory method AnnotationMetadata.introspect(Class)
items.translation: 支持工厂方法AnnotationMetadata.introspect(Class)。

items.source: in favor of StandardAnnotationMetadata
items.translation: 支持StandardAnnotationMetadata

items.source: in favor of obtaining instances via AnnotationMetadata
items.translation: 有利于通过AnnotationMetadata获取实例。

items.source: Assert a cookie's SameSite attribute with a Hamcrest Matcher.
items.translation: 使用 Hamcrest Matcher 断言 Cookie 的 SameSite 属性。

items.source: Invoked on creation of a new savepoint, either when a nested transaction is started against an existing transaction or on a programmatic savepoint via TransactionStatus.

items.source: Scan the specified packages and return a PersistenceManagedTypes that represents the result of the scanning.
items.translation: 扫描指定的包并返回一个代表扫描结果的PersistenceManagedTypes。

items.source: Variant of MethodInvokingRunnable meant to be used for processing of no-arg scheduled methods.
items.translation: `MethodInvokingRunnable` 的变体，旨在用于处理无参调度方法。

items.source: Context that holds information for observation metadata collection during the execution of scheduled tasks.
items.translation: 包含在计划任务执行期间的观察元数据收集信息的上下文。

items.source: Helper bean for registering tasks with a TaskScheduler, typically using cron expressions.
items.translation: 用于向 TaskScheduler 注册任务的辅助类，通常使用 cron 表达式。

items.source: Container annotation that aggregates several Scheduled annotations.
items.translation: 聚合多个 `Scheduled` 注解的容器注解。

items.source: A TaskExecutor extension exposing scheduling characteristics that are relevant to potential task submitters.

items.translation: 由 `ConfigurableBeanFactory` 使用的策略接口，代表用于存放 Bean 实例的目标作用域。

items.source: A subclass of BeanCreationException which indicates that the target scope is not active, for example, in case of request or session scope.
items.translation: 一个 `BeanCreationException` 的子类，表示目标作用域未激活，例如在请求或会话作用域的情况下。

items.source: The ScopeMetadataResolver to be used for resolving the scope of detected components.
items.translation: 用于解析检测到的组件范围的ScopeMetadataResolver接口。

items.source: Thrown by ScriptUtils if an SQL script cannot be properly parsed.
items.translation: 由ScriptUtils抛出，如果 SQL 脚本无法正确解析。

items.source: Thrown by ScriptUtils if an SQL script cannot be properly parsed.
items.translation: 由ScriptUtils抛出，如果 SQL 脚本无法正确解析。

items.translation: 由 ScriptUtils 抛出，当 SQL 脚本中的某条语句在执行时针对目标数据库失败。

items.translation: 由 ScriptUtils 抛出，当 SQL 脚本中的某个语句在执行时针对目标数据库失败。

items.translation: 用于配置 `WebSocketHandler` 请求处理的辅助类，包括 SockJS 回退选项。

items.translation: 为基于 Spring 的实体类扫描指定自定义类型过滤器。

items.source: Specify the environment for the JMX connector.
items.translation: 指定 JMX 连接器的环境。

items.source: Set the environment for the JNDI InitialContext.
items.translation: 设置 JNDI InitialContext 的环境。

items.source: Set the Environment to use when reading bean definitions.
items.translation: 设置读取 Bean 定义时使用的环境。

items.source: Set the SQL error codes to match.
items.translation: 将 SQL 错误代码设置为匹配。

items.source: Set the error handler.
items.translation: 设置错误处理器。

items.source:
Configure a handler for error messages sent to clients which allows
customizing the error messages or preventing them from being sent.
items.translation: 配置一个用于处理发送给客户端的错误消息的处理器，该处理器允许自定义错误消息或阻止其发送。

items.source: Set the evaluation context that will be used if none is specified on an evaluation call.
items.translation: 设置评估上下文，如果在评估调用中未指定则使用此上下文。

items.source: Set the name of the model attribute as which the exception should be exposed.
items.translation: 将模型属性的名称设置为应暴露异常的属性。

items.source: Set the exception class for the specified error codes.
items.translation: 为指定的错误代码设置异常类。

items.source:
Specify an JMS ExceptionListener implementation that should be
registered with the single Connection created by this factory.
items.translation: 指定一个要与该工厂创建的单个连接注册的 JMS ExceptionListener 实现。

items.source:
Set the JMS ExceptionListener to notify in case of a JMSException thrown
by the registered message listener or the invocation infrastructure.
items.translation: 将 JMS 异常监听器设置为在注册的消息监听器或调用基础设施抛出 JMSException 时发出通知。

items.source: Set the mappings between exception class names and error view names.
items.translation: 设置异常类名与错误视图名之间的映射关系。

items.source: Set the template used for method exception log messages.
items.translation: 设置用于方法异常日志消息的模板。

items.source: Set the list of exception resolvers to delegate to.
items.translation: 设置要委托的异常解析器列表。

items.source: Set the exception translator for this instance.
items.translation: 为此实例设置异常转换器。

items.source: Set the exception translator for this transaction manager.
items.translation: 为此事务管理器设置异常转换器。

items.source: Set a predicate to further filter the exchanges to handle.
items.translation: 设置一个谓词以进一步过滤需要处理的交易所。

items.source: Set the list of names for beans that should be excluded from auto-detection.
items.translation: 设置应排除在自动检测之外的 Bean 的名称列表。

items.source: Set one or more exceptions to be excluded from the exception mappings.
items.translation: 设置一个或多个要从异常映射中排除的异常。

items.source: Convenience method when we have only a single exclusion pattern.
items.translation: 当只有一个排除模式时使用的便捷方法。

items.source: Set the regular expressions defining methods to match for exclusion.
items.translation: 设置定义用于排除的方法的正则表达式。

items.source: Configure a predicate to exclude validators.
items.translation: 配置一个谓词以排除验证器。

items.source: Set whether to execute existing delayed tasks even when this executor has been shutdown.
items.translation: 设置是否在执行此执行器已关闭时仍运行现有的延迟任务。

items.source: Supply the executor to be used when executing async methods.
items.translation: 提供用于执行异步方法的执行器。

items.source: Set the template used for method exit log messages.
items.translation: 设置用于方法退出日志消息的模板。

items.source: Whether to treat the redirect URL as a URI template.
items.translation: 是否将重定向 URL 视为 URI 模板。

items.source:
Specify the type that the located JNDI object is supposed
to be assignable to, if any.
items.translation: 指定定位到的 JNDI 对象应可赋值给的类型（如有）。

items.source: Set the expiration time for the FlashMap.
items.translation: 设置 FlashMap 的过期时间。

items.source: Set the "Expires" attribute for this cookie.
items.translation: 为此 Cookie 设置“Expires”属性。

items.source:
Set if the QOS values (deliveryMode, priority, timeToLive)
should be used for sending a message.
items.translation: 设置是否应使用 QoS 值（deliveryMode、priority、timeToLive）来发送消息。

items.source:
Set whether to expose the JNDI environment context for all access to the target
object, i.e.
items.translation: 设置是否向访问目标对象的所有请求暴露 JNDI 环境上下文，即。

items.source: Set whether to expose the JMX descriptor field "class" for managed operations.
items.translation: 设置是否公开受管操作的 JMX 描述符字段"class"。

items.source:
Set the list of response headers that an actual response might have
and can be exposed to the client.
items.translation: 设置实际响应可能具有并可暴露给客户端的响应头列表。

items.source: Specify whether to add path variables to the model or not.
items.translation: 指定是否将路径变量添加到模型中。

items.source:
Specify whether views resolved by this resolver should add path
variables to the model or not.
items.translation: 指定此解析器解析的视图是否应将路径变量添加到模型中。

items.source:
Set whether the proxy should be exposed by the AOP framework as a
ThreadLocal for retrieval via the AopContext class.
items.translation: 设置是否由 AOP 框架将代理作为 ThreadLocal 暴露，以便通过 AopContext 类进行检索。

items.source: Set the expression to evaluate.
items.translation: 设置要评估的表达式。

items.source: Specify the EL parser to use for expression parsing.
items.translation: 指定用于表达式解析的 EL 解析器。

items.source: Set the prefix that an expression string starts with.
items.translation: 设置表达式字符串的起始前缀。

items.source: Set the suffix that an expression string ends with.
items.translation: 设置表达式字符串的结尾后缀。

items.source:
Set the name of a static factory method to use for this definition,
to be called on this bean's class.
items.translation: 为此定义设置一个静态工厂方法的名称，该方法将在此 Bean 的类上调用。

items.source:
Set the name of a non-static factory method to use for this definition,
including the bean name of the factory instance to call the method on.
items.translation: 为此定义设置一个非静态工厂方法的名称，包括用于调用该方法的工厂实例的 Bean 名称。

items.source:
Set whether to fail early in case of the transaction being globally marked
as rollback-only.
items.translation: 设置是否在事务被全局标记为仅回滚时提前失败。

items.source:
Set whether to allow a fallback to a type match if no explicit name has been
specified.
items.translation: 设置是否允许在未指定显式名称时回退到类型匹配。

items.source:
Set whether this resolver is supposed to create dynamic destinations
if the destination name is not found in JNDI.
items.translation: 设置此解析器是否应在 JNDI 中未找到目标名称时创建动态目标。

items.source:
Set whether to fall back to the system Locale if no files for a specific
Locale have been found.
items.translation: 设置是否在未找到特定 Locale 的文件时回退到系统 Locale。

items.source:
Set the fallback translator to use when this translator cannot find a
specific match itself.
items.translation: 设置此翻译器无法自行找到特定匹配项时使用的备用翻译器。

items.source: Set the Rome feed type to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的 Rome 馈送类型。

items.source: Set the fetch size for this JdbcTemplate.
items.translation: 为此 JdbcTemplate 设置获取大小。

items.source: Set the fetch size for this RDBMS operation.
items.translation: 为此 RDBMS 操作设置获取大小。

items.source: Set the field alias/type map, consisting of field names.
items.translation: 设置字段别名/类型映射，该映射由字段名组成。

items.source:
Specify a prefix that can be used for parameters that indicate default
value fields, having "prefix + field" as name.
items.translation: 指定一个可用于指示默认值字段的参数的前缀，其名称为“前缀 + 字段”。

items.source:
Specify a prefix that can be used for parameters that mark potentially
empty fields, having "prefix + field" as name.
items.translation: 指定一个可用于标记可能为空字段的参数的前缀，其名称为“前缀 + 字段”。

items.source: Set the encoding to use for parsing properties files.
items.translation: 设置用于解析属性文件的编码。

items.source: Set per-file charsets to use for parsing properties files.
items.translation: 设置用于解析属性文件的每文件字符集。

items.source: Set the list of supported file extensions.
items.translation: 设置支持的文件扩展名列表。

items.source: Set the Jackson filter provider to serialize the POJO with.
items.translation: 将 Jackson 过滤器提供者设置为用于序列化 POJO 的提供者。

items.source: Specify triggered tasks as a Map of Runnables (the tasks) and fixed-delay values.
items.translation: 将触发的任务指定为 Runnable（任务）和固定延迟值的 Map。

items.source: Configure how unknown String keys will be handled.
items.translation: 配置如何处理未知的 String 键。

items.source:
Set whether to schedule as fixed-rate execution, rather than
fixed-delay execution.
items.translation: 设置是否按固定速率执行，而不是按固定延迟执行。

items.source:
Specify whether the periodic interval should be measured between the
scheduled start times rather than between actual completion times.
items.translation: 指定是否应在计划开始时间之间测量周期性间隔，而不是在实际完成时间之间。

items.source: Specify triggered tasks as a Map of Runnables (the tasks) and fixed-rate values.
items.translation: 将触发的任务指定为 Runnable（任务）和固定频率值的 Map。

items.source:
Changes the computation strategy of method properties like max stack size, max number of local
variables, and frames.
items.translation: 更改诸如最大堆栈大小、最大局部变量数和帧数等方法属性的计算策略。

items.source: Provide a custom FlashMapManager instance.
items.translation: 提供自定义的 FlashMapManager 实例。

items.source:
Specify the format name, to be resolved by the JSR-354 provider
at runtime.
items.translation: 指定格式名称，以便在运行时由 JSR-354 提供者解析。

items.source: Set a global date formatter to register.
items.translation: 设置全局日期格式化器以注册。

items.source: Configure the set of custom formatter objects that should be added.
items.translation: 配置要添加的自定义格式化器对象集。

items.source: Set the converter to use for parsing form content.
items.translation: 设置用于解析表单内容的转换器。

items.source:
Enable processing of forwarded headers, either extracting and removing,
or remove only.
items.translation: 启用转发标头的处理，可选择提取并移除，或仅移除。

items.source: Specify the desired number of fraction digits.
items.translation: 指定所需的小数位数。

items.source: Set whether this config should be frozen.
items.translation: 设置是否冻结此配置。

items.source: Specify whether this call is a function call.
items.translation: 请指定此调用是否为函数调用。

items.source: Set whether this call is for a function.
items.translation: 设置此调用是否为函数调用。

items.source: Specify the name used for the return value of the function.
items.translation: 指定函数返回值的名称。

items.source:
Set whether to generate DDL after the EntityManagerFactory has been initialized,
creating/updating all relevant tables.
items.translation: 设置是否在 EntityManagerFactory 初始化后生成 DDL，以创建/更新所有相关表。

items.source: Specify the name of a single generated key column.
items.translation: 指定单个生成的键列的名称。

items.source: Set the names of any generated keys.
items.translation: 设置任何生成键的名称。

items.source: Set the column names of the auto-generated keys.
items.translation: 设置自动生成的键的列名。

items.source:
Set the globally scoped bindings on the underlying script engine manager,
shared by all scripts, as an alternative to script argument bindings.
items.translation: 在底层脚本引擎管理器上设置全局作用域绑定，该管理器由所有脚本共享，以此作为脚本参数绑定的替代方案。

items.source: Specify global Quartz JobListeners to be registered with the Scheduler.
items.translation: 指定全局 Quartz JobListeners 以注册到调度器。

items.source:
Set whether to globally mark an existing transaction as rollback-only
after a participating transaction failed.
items.translation: 设置是否在参与的事务失败后，将现有事务全局标记为仅回滚。

items.source: Specify global Quartz TriggerListeners to be registered with the Scheduler.
items.translation: 指定全局 Quartz TriggerListeners 以注册到调度器。

items.source: Specify the trigger's group.
items.translation: 指定触发器的组。

items.source: Specify the job's group.
items.translation: 指定作业的组。

items.source: Set the group of the job.
items.translation: 设置作业所属组。

items.source: Set the HandlerExceptionResolver types to use as a list.
items.translation: 将要使用的 HandlerExceptionResolver 类型设置为列表。

items.source: Set the HandlerExceptionResolver types to use as an array.
items.translation: 将要使用的 HandlerExceptionResolver 类型设置为数组。

items.source: Manually configure the resource mappings.
items.translation: 手动配置资源映射。

items.source:
Configure the naming strategy to use for assigning a default name to every
mapped handler method.
items.translation: 配置用于为每个映射的处理程序方法分配默认名称的命名策略。

items.source:
Configure a predicate for selecting which Spring beans to check for the
presence of message handler methods.
items.translation: 配置一个谓词，用于选择要检查是否存在消息处理方法的 Spring 圈。

items.source:
Configure a predicate for extended matching of the handler that was
matched by URL path.
items.translation: 为通过 URL 路径匹配的处理器配置扩展匹配谓词。

items.source: Configure the HandshakeHandler to use.
items.translation: 配置要使用的 HandshakeHandler。

items.source: Configure one or more WebSocket handshake request interceptors.
items.translation: 配置一个或多个 WebSocket 握手请求拦截器。

items.source: Set the value for the given header name.
items.translation: 设置给定标头名称的值。

items.source:
Set the value for the given header name only if the header name is not already
associated with a value.
items.translation: 仅当该标头名称尚未关联值时，才设置给定标头名称的值。

items.source:
Set the value for the given header name only if the header name is not
already associated with a value.
items.translation: 仅在给定标头名称尚未关联值时，设置该标头的值。

items.source: Set the name of the session header to use for the session ID.
items.translation: 将用于会话 ID 的会话头名称设置为。

items.source: Set headers on the given servlet response.
items.translation: 在指定的 Servlet 响应上设置标头。

items.source: Provide default headers to add to the WebSocket handshake request.
items.translation: 为 WebSocket 握手请求提供要添加的默认标头。

items.source: Set the heartbeat header.
items.translation: 设置心跳头。

items.source:
Specify the amount of time in milliseconds when the server has not sent
any messages and after which the server should send a heartbeat frame
to the client in order to keep the connection from breaking.
items.translation: 指定服务器未发送任何消息的时间（以毫秒为单位），在此时间过后，服务器应向客户端发送心跳帧以保持连接不中断。

items.source: Configure the value for the heartbeat settings.
items.translation: 配置心跳设置的值。

items.source: Configure the value for the heart-beat settings.
items.translation: 配置心跳设置的值。

items.source: Set Hibernate properties, such as "hibernate.dialect".
items.translation: 设置 Hibernate 属性，例如"hibernate.dialect"。

items.source: Set the mail server host, typically an SMTP host.
items.translation: 设置邮件服务器主机，通常为 SMTP 主机。

items.source: Set the host header.
items.translation: 设置主机标头。

items.source: Set the proxy host name.
items.translation: 设置代理主机名。

items.source: Set HTML escaping for this tag, as boolean value.
items.translation: 为此标签设置 HTML 转义，值为布尔值。

items.source: Set whether to stay compatible with HTTP 1.0 clients.
items.translation: 设置是否保持与 HTTP 1.0 客户端的兼容性。

items.source:
The number of server-to-client messages that a session can cache while waiting
for the next HTTP polling request from the client.
items.translation: 会话在等待客户端的下一个 HTTP 轮询请求时，可以缓存的服务器到客户端消息的数量。

items.source: Configure the HTTP method(s) over which the locale can be changed.
items.translation: 配置可以更改区域设置的 HTTP 方法。

items.source: Set the id header.
items.translation: 设置 id 标题。

items.source: Set the unique ID of this application context.
items.translation: 设置此应用程序上下文的唯一 ID。

items.source: Set the unique id of this application context.
items.translation: 设置此应用程序上下文的唯一 ID。

items.source: Set a custom id for this endpoint.
items.translation: 为此端点设置自定义 ID。

items.source:
Specify the limit for the number of consumers that are allowed to be idle
at any given time.
items.translation: 指定允许在任何给定时间处于空闲状态的消费者数量限制。

items.source:
Marks the consumer as 'idle' after the specified number of idle receives
have been reached.
items.translation: 在达到指定数量的空闲接收后，将消费者标记为“空闲”。

items.source:
Specify the limit for idle executions of a consumer task, not having
received any message within its execution.
items.translation: 指定消费者任务的空闲执行限制，即在未在其执行期间收到任何消息的情况下的限制。

items.source: Set whether upper and lower case in String values should be ignored.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略字符串值中的大小写。

items.source: Specify the unknown properties (not found in the bean) that should be ignored.
items.translation: 指定应忽略的未知属性（在 Bean 中未找到）。

items.source:
Set whether to ignore invalid fields, that is, whether to ignore bind
parameters that have corresponding fields in the target object which are
not accessible (for example because of null values in the nested path).
items.translation: 设置是否忽略无效字段，即是否忽略目标对象中具有对应字段但不可访问的绑定参数（例如由于嵌套路径中的空值导致）。

items.source: Set whether to ignore invalid keys.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略无效键。

items.source: Set whether to ignore an invalid value for the locale parameter.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略区域参数（locale parameter）的无效值。

items.source: Set whether to ignore a nested path, if any.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略嵌套路径（如果有）。

items.source: Set if failure to find the property resource should be ignored.
items.translation: 设置是否应忽略查找属性资源失败的情况。

items.source: Whether to ignore requests with unknown file extension.
items.translation: 是否忽略具有未知文件扩展名的请求。

items.source:
Set whether to ignore unknown fields, that is, whether to ignore bind
parameters that do not have corresponding fields in the target object.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略未知字段，即是否忽略目标对象中没有对应字段的绑定参数。

items.source:
Set whether to throw an exception when encountering an unresolvable placeholder
nested within the value of a given property.
items.translation: 设置是否在遇到给定属性值中无法解析的嵌套占位符时抛出异常。

items.source:
Specify whether to throw an exception when encountering an unresolvable placeholder
nested within the value of a given property.
items.translation: 指定在遇到给定属性值中嵌套的无法解析的占位符时是否抛出异常。

items.source: Set whether to ignore unresolvable placeholders.
items.translation: 设置是否忽略无法解析的占位符。

items.source: Configure the maximum size allowed for inbound STOMP message.
items.translation: 配置允许传入 STOMP 消息的最大大小。

items.source:
Specify a prefix to be appended to the message header name for any
user-defined property that is being mapped into the MessageHeaders.
items.translation: 指定一个前缀，将其附加到任何映射到 MessageHeaders 的用户定义属性消息头名称上。

items.source: Specify whether to register annotation config post-processors.
items.translation: 指定是否注册注解配置后置处理器。

items.source:
Set whether the client address and session id should be included in the
log message.
items.translation: 设置是否将客户端地址和会话 ID 包含在日志消息中。

items.source: Set whether the request headers should be included in the log message.
items.translation: 设置是否将请求头包含在日志消息中。

items.source: Set a list of regex patterns, matching eligible @AspectJ bean names.
items.translation: 设置一组正则表达式模式，以匹配符合条件的@AspectJ bean 名称。

items.source: Set whether the request payload (body) should be included in the log message.
items.translation: 设置是否将请求负载（正文）包含在日志消息中。

items.source: Set whether the query string should be included in the log message.
items.translation: 设置是否将查询字符串包含在日志消息中。

items.source: Set the name of the sequence/table.
items.translation: 设置序列/表的名称。

items.source: Set the index of this parameter in the operation signature.
items.translation: 设置该参数在操作签名中的索引。

items.source: Set the list of index accessors to use in this evaluation context.
items.translation: 在此评估上下文中设置要使用的索引访问器列表。

items.source:
Specify the init annotation to check for, indicating initialization
methods to call after configuration of a bean.
items.translation: 指定要检查的 init 注解，以指示在配置完 Bean 后调用的初始化方法。

items.source: Specify the delay for the initial execution.
items.translation: 指定初始执行的延迟时间。

items.source: Set the initial interval.
items.translation: 设置初始间隔。

items.source: Set the default init-method setting for the document that's currently parsed.
items.translation: 设置当前解析文档的默认 init-method 设置。

items.source: Set the name of the initializer method.
items.translation: 设置初始化方法的名称。

items.source: Set the init method for this definition.
items.translation: 为此定义设置初始化方法。

items.source: Set the name of the default initializer method.
items.translation: 设置默认初始化方法的名称。

items.source: Specify the names of multiple initializer methods.
items.translation: 指定多个初始化方法的名称。

items.source:
Specify init parameters for the servlet to wrap,
as name-value pairs.
items.translation: 为要包装的 Servlet 指定初始化参数，格式为名称 - 值对。

items.source: Set the name of the ServletContext init parameter to expose.
items.translation: 将 ServletContext 初始化参数的名称设置为 expose。

items.source: Set the names of in parameters to be used.
items.translation: 设置要使用的入参名称。

items.source:
Specify a callback for creating an instance of the bean,
as an alternative to a declaratively specified factory method.

of a JSESSIONID cookie is required for the application to function correctly, for example,
for load balancing or in Java Servlet containers for the use of an HTTP session.
items.translation: SockJS 协议要求服务器对客户端的初始 "/info" 请求做出响应，其中包含一个名为 "cookie_needed" 的布尔属性，该属性指示应用程序是否正确运行是否需要使用 JSESSIONID cookie（例如，用于负载均衡或在 Java Servlet 容器中用于 HTTP 会话）。

items.source: Configure the persistence strategy.
items.translation: 配置持久化策略。

items.source:
Set a list of names of shareable JNDI resources,
which this factory is allowed to cache once obtained.
items.translation: 设置可共享的 JNDI 资源名称列表，工厂在获取后允许缓存这些资源。

items.source:
Indicate whether Connections obtained from the target factory are supposed
to be stopped before closed ("true") or simply closed ("false").
items.translation: 指示从目标工厂获取的连接在关闭之前是否应该停止（"true"）还是只需关闭（"false"）。

items.source: Set whether to show SQL in the log (or in the console).
items.translation: 设置是否在日志（或控制台）中显示 SQL。

items.source: Configure the amount of time we'll wait before shutting down resources.
items.translation: 配置在关闭资源之前等待的时间。

items.source: Set the value of the singleton property.
items.translation: 设置单例属性的值。

items.source:
Set whether a shared 'singleton' Properties instance should be
created, or rather a new Properties instance on each request.
items.translation: 设置是创建一个共享的'singleton'Properties 实例，还是在每个请求上创建一个新的 Properties 实例。

items.source: Set whether results processing should be skipped.
items.translation: 设置是否跳过结果处理。

items.source: Set whether undeclared results should be skipped.
items.translation: 设置是否跳过未声明的结果。

items.source: Set the sort definition for this holder.
items.translation: 为此持有者设置排序定义。

items.source: Set the source list for this holder.
items.translation: 为此持有者设置源列表。

items.source: Set the source List, typically populated via XML "list" elements.
items.translation: 设置源列表，通常通过 XML 中的"list"元素填充。

items.source: Set the source Map, typically populated via XML "map" elements.
items.translation: 设置源映射，通常通过 XML 中的 "map" 元素填充。

items.source: Set the source Set, typically populated via XML "set" elements.
items.translation: 设置源 Set，通常通过 XML 的 "set" 元素填充。

items.source: Set the type name as actually specified for this particular value, if any.
items.translation: 将类型名称设置为该特定值实际指定的名称（如果有）。

items.source: Set the SQL executed by this operation.
items.translation: 设置此操作执行的 SQL。

items.source: Set custom error codes to be used for translation.
items.translation: 设置自定义错误代码以用于翻译。

items.source: Set whether the SQL can be used as is.
items.translation: 设置是否可以直接使用 SQL。

items.source: Specify the encoding for SQL scripts, if different from the platform encoding.
items.translation: 如果与平台编码不同，请指定 SQL 脚本的编码。

items.source:
Set the number of seconds to wait after initialization before
starting the scheduler asynchronously.
items.translation: 设置初始化后等待的秒数，然后再异步启动调度器。

items.source:
Set a fully qualified static field name to retrieve,
for example, "example.MyExampleClass.MY_EXAMPLE_FIELD".
items.translation: 设置一个完全限定的静态字段名称以获取，例如"example.MyExampleClass.MY_EXAMPLE_FIELD"。

items.source:
Set a fully qualified static method name to invoke,
for example, "example.MyExampleClass.myExampleMethod".
items.translation: 设置要调用的完全限定静态方法名，例如"example.MyExampleClass.myExampleMethod"。

items.source: Set the HTTP status to use for the response.
items.translation: 将用于响应的 HTTP 状态设置为：

items.source: Set the HTTP status code of the response.
items.translation: 设置响应的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source:
Configure the HTTP status code that this controller should set on the
response.
items.translation: 配置此控制器应在响应中设置的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source: Set the specific redirect 3xx status code to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的特定重定向 3xx 状态码。

items.source: Set the status code to set on the response.
items.translation: 将状态码设置为要在响应中设置的状态码。

items.source: Set the status code for this view.
items.translation: 为此视图设置状态码。

items.source:
Set the HTTP status code that this exception resolver will apply for a given
resolved error view.
items.translation: 设置此异常解析器针对给定解析错误视图将应用的 HTTP 状态码。

items.source:
The property can be used to indicate the request is considered fully
handled within the controller and that no view should be used for rendering.
items.translation: 该属性可用于指示请求已在控制器中完全处理，且不应使用视图进行渲染。

items.source:
Specify the ConcurrentMap to use as an internal store
(possibly pre-populated).
items.translation: 指定要用作内部存储（可能已预填充）的 ConcurrentMap。

items.source: Specify whether the database uses lower case for identifiers.
items.translation: 指定数据库是否对标识符使用小写。

items.source: Specify whether the database uses upper case for identifiers.
items.translation: 指定数据库是否对标识符使用大写。

items.source: Set the exact list of strategies to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的确切策略列表。

items.source: Set the strategy to use to create the bytecode from this generator.
items.translation: 设置用于从此生成器创建字节码的策略。

items.source:
Streaming transports save responses on the client side and don't free
memory used by delivered messages.
items.translation: 流式传输传输会在客户端保存响应，并且不会释放已传递消息所使用的内存。

items.source:
Specify whether this resolver should strictly comply with the Servlet
specification, only kicking in for "multipart/form-data" requests.
items.translation: 指定此解析器是否应严格遵循 Servlet 规范，仅针对 "multipart/form-data" 请求生效。

items.source: Set the array of recognized Strings.
items.translation: 设置已识别字符串的数组。

items.source:
Set whether file extensions should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name.
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中剥离文件扩展名。

items.source:
Set whether leading slashes should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name.
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中剥离前导斜杠。

items.source:
Set whether trailing slashes should be stripped from the URI when
generating the view name.
items.translation: 设置是否在生成视图名称时从 URI 中删除尾随斜杠。

items.source: Set the subject of the message, using the correct encoding.
items.translation: 设置消息主题，并使用正确的编码。

items.source: Set the sub-protocols to use.
items.translation: 设置要使用的子协议。

items.source: Set the name for the durable subscription.
items.translation: 设置持久化订阅的名称。

items.source: Set whether to make the subscription durable.
items.translation: 设置是否使订阅持久化。

items.source: Set the name of a subscription to create.
items.translation: 设置要创建的订阅的名称。

items.source: Set whether to make the subscription shared.
items.translation: 设置是否使订阅共享。

items.source: Set the text that will get prepended to the trace data.
items.translation: 设置将附加到跟踪数据的前缀文本。

items.source:
Set the suffix to append to the request URL filename
to build a view name.
items.translation: 将后缀设置为附加到请求 URL 文件名以构建视图名称。

items.source: Set the suffix to append to generated view names.
items.translation: 设置要附加到生成的视图名称的后缀。

items.source: Specify a deprecation date for the "Sunset" response header.
items.translation: 为"Sunset"响应头指定一个弃用日期。

items.source: Set the classes supported by this marshaller.
items.translation: 设置此反序列化器支持的类。

items.source: Set the supported media types for this view.
items.translation: 为此视图设置支持的媒体类型。

items.source: Set the HTTP methods that this content generator should support.
items.translation: 设置此内容生成器应支持的 HTTP 方法。

items.source: Use this property to configure the list of supported sub-protocols.
items.translation: 使用此属性配置支持的子协议列表。

items.source: Set the supported types that can be loaded from YAML documents.
items.translation: 设置可以从 YAML 文档加载的支持类型。

items.source: Specify whether the database supports the use of catalog name in procedure calls.
items.translation: 指定数据库是否支持在过程调用中使用目录名称。

items.source: Specify whether the database supports the use of schema name in procedure calls.
items.translation: 指定数据库是否支持在过程调用中使用模式名称。

items.source:
Specify whether the returned Connection should be a close-suppressing proxy
or the physical Connection.
items.translation: 指定返回的 Connection 应为抑制关闭的代理还是物理 Connection。

items.source:
This option can be used to disable automatic addition of CORS headers for
SockJS requests.
items.translation: 此选项可用于禁用 SockJS 请求的自动添加 CORS 标头。

items.source:
Set whether to allow for a local JMS transaction that is synchronized with a
Spring-managed transaction (where the main transaction might be a JDBC-based
one for a specific DataSource, for example), with the JMS transaction committing
right after the main transaction.
items.translation: 设置是否允许本地 JMS 事务与 Spring 管理的事务同步（例如，主事务可能是针对特定 DataSource 的基于 JDBC 的事务），并在主事务提交后立即提交 JMS 事务。

items.source:
Set whether to automatically join ongoing transactions (according
to the JPA 2.1 SynchronizationType rules).
items.translation: 设置是否自动加入正在进行的交易（根据 JPA 2.1 的 SynchronizationType 规则）。

items.source: Mark the resource as synchronized with a transaction.
items.translation: 将资源标记为与事务同步。

items.source:
Set whether this bean is 'synthetic', that is, not defined by
the application itself.
items.translation: 设置该 Bean 是否为“合成”的，即不是由应用程序本身定义的。

items.source:
Set the maximum interval, in milliseconds, at which the "system" relay session
expects, in the absence of any other data, to receive a heartbeat from the STOMP
broker.
items.translation: 设置“system"中继会话期望接收来自 STOMP 代理心跳的最大间隔（以毫秒为单位），在没有其他数据的情况下。

items.source:
Set the maximum interval, in milliseconds, at which the "system" connection
expects, in the absence of any other data, to receive a heartbeat from the STOMP
broker.
items.translation: 设置“system"连接期望接收来自 STOMP 代理心跳的最大间隔（以毫秒为单位），在没有其他数据的情况下。

items.source:
Set the interval, in milliseconds, at which the "system" relay session will,
in the absence of any other data being sent, send a heartbeat to the STOMP broker.
items.translation: 设置“system"中继会话在没有任何其他数据发送的情况下，向 STOMP 代理发送心跳的间隔（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source:
Set the interval, in milliseconds, at which the "system" connection will, in the
absence of any other data being sent, send a heartbeat to the STOMP broker.
items.translation: 设置以毫秒为单位的间隔，在此间隔内，若无其他数据发送，“system”连接将向 STOMP 代理发送心跳。

items.source:
Set the login for the shared "system" connection used to send messages to
the STOMP broker from within the application, i.e.
items.translation: 在应用程序内部设置用于向 STOMP 代理发送消息的共享“system”连接的登录信息，即

items.source:
Set the passcode for the shared "system" connection used to send messages to
the STOMP broker from within the application, i.e.
items.translation: 在应用程序内部设置用于向 STOMP 代理发送消息的共享"system"连接的密码，即：

items.source: Set how to check system properties: as fallback, as override, or never.
items.translation: 设置如何检查系统属性：作为后备、作为覆盖，或从不。

items.source:
Set the system property mode by the name of the corresponding constant,
for example, "SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_MODE_OVERRIDE".
items.translation: 通过对应常量的名称设置系统属性模式，例如"SYSTEM_PROPERTIES_MODE_OVERRIDE"。

items.source:
Configure one more destinations to subscribe to on the shared "system"
connection along with MessageHandler's to handle received messages.
items.translation: 在共享的 "system" 连接上配置另一个目的地以订阅，并配置 MessageHandler 来处理接收到的消息。

items.source: Set the name of the table for this context.
items.translation: 为此上下文设置表名。

items.source: Set the name of the table for this insert.
items.translation: 为此插入语句设置表名。

items.source: Set the target object, that is, the bean to be wrapped with a transactional proxy.
items.translation: 设置目标对象，即需要以事务代理包装的 Bean。

items.source: Set the given object as target.
items.translation: 将给定的对象设为目标。

items.source: Set the name of the target bean in the Spring application context.
items.translation: 在 Spring 应用程序上下文中设置目标 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Set the name of the bean that is to be scoped.
items.translation: 设置要作用域的 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Set the name of the target bean in the factory.
items.translation: 在工厂中设置目标 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Specify the name of a target bean to apply the property path to.
items.translation: 指定要应用属性路径的目标 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Set the name of the target bean in the Spring BeanFactory.
items.translation: 在 Spring BeanFactory 中设置目标 Bean 的名称。

items.source: Set the target CacheManager to proxy.
items.translation: 将目标 CacheManager 设置为代理。

items.source:
Set a target class to be proxied, indicating that the proxy
should be castable to the given class.
items.translation: 设置一个目标类作为代理对象，表明该代理应可强制转换为给定类。

items.source: Set the target class on which the field is defined.
items.translation: 设置定义该字段的目标类。

items.source: Set the target class on which to call the target method.
items.translation: 设置要调用目标方法的目标类。

items.source:
Specify the target class explicitly, to avoid any kind of access to the
target bean (for example, to avoid initialization of a FactoryBean instance).
items.translation: 显式指定目标类，以避免对目标 Bean 进行任何访问（例如，避免初始化 FactoryBean 实例）。

items.source:
Set the target ConnectionFactory which will be used to lazily
create a single Connection.
items.translation: 设置目标 ConnectionFactory，该工厂将用于懒式创建单个 Connection。

items.source: Set the target DataSource that this DataSource should delegate to.
items.translation: 设置此 DataSource 应委托的目标 DataSource。

items.source: Specify the map of target DataSources, with the lookup key as key.
items.translation: 指定目标 DataSource 的映射，以查找键作为键。

items.source: Set the target DestinationResolver to delegate to.
items.translation: 将目标 DestinationResolver 设置为委派给的对象。

items.source: Set the name of the field to be retrieved.
items.translation: 将要检索的字段名称设置为。

items.source: Set the class to use for the target List.
items.translation: 设置目标列表使用的类。

items.source: Set the class to use for the target Map.
items.translation: 设置目标 Map 要使用的类。

items.source: Set the name of the method to be invoked.
items.translation: 将要调用的方法名设置为。

items.source: Set the target object on which the field is defined.
items.translation: 设置定义该字段的对象。

items.source: Set the target object on which to call the target method.
items.translation: 设置要调用目标方法的目标对象。

items.source: Specify a target object to apply the property path to.
items.translation: 指定目标对象以应用属性路径。

items.source: Provide a URL path to help identify the target request for this FlashMap.
items.translation: 为此 FlashMap 提供用于识别目标请求的 URL 路径。

items.source: Set the class to use for the target Set.
items.translation: 设置目标 Set 要使用的类。

items.source: Specify the target type of this bean definition, if known in advance.
items.translation: 指定该 Bean 定义的目标类型（如果已知）。

items.source: Set the type to convert to.
items.translation: 设置要转换的类型。

items.source: Specify a generics-containing target type of this bean definition, if known in advance.
items.translation: 如果已知，请指定此 Bean 定义的包含泛型的目标类型。

items.source: Set the type for the target object.
items.translation: 设置目标对象的类型。

items.source: Specify the type to convert to.
items.translation: 指定要转换的目标类型。

items.source:
Set the Spring TaskExecutor to use for executing the listener once
a message has been received by the provider.
items.translation: 设置 Spring TaskExecutor 以在提供者接收到消息后执行一次监听器。

items.source:
Some STOMP clients (for example, stomp-js) always send heartbeats at a fixed rate
but others (Spring STOMP client) do so only when no other messages are
sent.
items.translation: 某些 STOMP 客户端（例如，stomp-js）始终以固定速率发送心跳，而其他客户端（如 Spring STOMP 客户端）仅在未发送其他消息时才发送心跳。

items.source: Configure the TaskScheduler to use for receipt tracking.
items.translation: 配置 TaskScheduler 以用于收据跟踪。

items.source: Configure a scheduler to use for heartbeats and for receipt tracking.
items.translation: 配置用于心跳和接收跟踪的调度器。

items.source:
Provide the TaskScheduler to use for SockJS endpoints for which a task
scheduler has not been explicitly registered.
items.translation: 为那些未显式注册任务调度器的 SockJS 端点提供要使用的 TaskScheduler。

items.source:
Specify a timeout (in milliseconds) for task termination when closing
this executor.
items.translation: 关闭此执行器时，指定任务终止的超时时间（以毫秒为单位）。

items.source: Configure a TCP client for managing TCP connections to the STOMP broker.
items.translation: 配置一个用于管理到 STOMP 代理的 TCP 连接的 TCP 客户端。

items.source: Specify a temporary ClassLoader to use for type matching purposes.
items.translation: 指定用于类型匹配的临时 ClassLoader。

items.source:
Set a pre-configured MarkupTemplateEngine to use for the Groovy Markup
Template web configuration.
items.translation: 为 Groovy 标记模板 Web 配置设置一个预配置的 MarkupTemplateEngine。

items.source: Set the MarkupTemplateEngine to use in this view.
items.translation: 在此视图中设置要使用的 MarkupTemplateEngine。

items.source: Set the Freemarker template loader path via a Spring resource location.
items.translation: 通过 Spring 资源位置设置 Freemarker 模板加载器路径。

items.source: Set multiple Freemarker template loader paths via Spring resource locations.
items.translation: 通过 Spring 资源位置设置多个 Freemarker 模板加载器路径。

items.source: Pointcut matching all bean property setters, in any class.
items.translation: 匹配所有类中所有 Bean 属性设置器的切点。

items.source: Set the message text for this tag.
items.translation: 设置此标签的消息文本。

items.source:
Set the given plain text and HTML text as alternatives, offering
both options to the email client.
items.translation: 将给定的纯文本和 HTML 文本设置为替代选项，向邮件客户端提供这两种选项。

items.source:
Specify an external factory to use for creating new Threads,
instead of relying on the local properties of this executor.
items.translation: 指定一个外部工厂用于创建新线程，而不是依赖此执行器的本地属性。

items.source: Set the ThreadFactory to use for the ExecutorService's thread pool.
items.translation: 设置用于 ExecutorService 线程池的 ThreadFactory。

items.source: Set the factory for creating new ForkJoinWorkerThreads.
items.translation: 设置用于创建新 ForkJoinWorkerThread 的工厂。

items.source: Specify the thread group that threads should be created in.
items.translation: 指定线程应创建的线程组。

items.source: Specify the name of the thread group that threads should be created in.
items.translation: 指定线程应创建的线程组名称。

items.source: Specify the prefix to use for the names of newly created threads.
items.translation: 指定用于新创建线程名称的前缀。

items.source: Configure the thread prefix to initialize the executor with.
items.translation: 配置线程前缀以初始化执行器。

items.source: Set the priority of the threads that this factory creates.
items.translation: 设置该工厂所创建线程的优先级。

items.source:
Whether the thread sending a reply should have an exception raised if the
receiving thread isn't going to receive the reply either because it timed out,
or because it already received a reply, or because it got an exception while
sending the request message.
items.translation: 发送回复的线程是否应在接收线程无法收到该回复时抛出异常，原因可能包括：超时、已收到回复，或在发送请求消息时发生异常。

items.source:
We need to hold the throwing name at this level for argument binding calculations,
this method allows the afterThrowing advice subclass to set the name.
items.translation: 我们在此级别需要保留抛出名称，以便进行参数绑定计算，此方法允许 `afterThrowing` 建议子类设置该名称。

items.source:
Set the time between eviction runs that check idle objects whether
they have been idle for too long or have become invalid.
items.translation: 设置检查空闲对象是否闲置过久或已失效的驱逐运行之间的时间间隔。

items.source: Set the formatter that will be used for objects representing time values.
items.translation: 设置用于表示时间值的对象的格式化程序。

items.source:
Set the timeout (in seconds) after which a fatal exception
will be thrown.
items.translation: 设置超时时间（以秒为单位），超过该时间后将抛出致命异常。

items.source: Set the timeout to apply, as number of seconds.
items.translation: 将超时设置为要应用的秒数。

items.source:
By default this is set to 10000 (10 seconds) even though the Servlet API
specifies a default async request timeout of 30 seconds.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为 10000（10 秒），尽管 Servlet API 规范规定的异步请求超时默认为 30 秒。

items.source: Set the time required for concurrent handling to complete.
items.translation: 设置并发处理所需的时间以完成。

items.source:
In Servlet 3 async processing, the timeout period begins after the
container processing thread has exited.
items.translation: 在 Servlet 3 异步处理中，超时时间从容器处理线程退出后开始计算。

items.source: Set the timeout for this object in milliseconds.
items.translation: 将此对象的超时时间设置为毫秒数。

items.source: Set the timeout for this object in seconds.
items.translation: 将此对象的超时时间设置为秒数。

items.source:
Set the timeout to apply, if any,
as a String value that resolves to a number of seconds.
items.translation: 将超时设置为要应用的字符串值（如果有的话），该值解析为秒数。

items.source: Set the style to use for time types.
items.translation: 设置时间类型使用的样式。

items.source:
Set the maximum time allowed in milliseconds after the WebSocket connection
is established and before the first sub-protocol message is received.
items.translation: 设置 WebSocket 连接建立后、收到第一个子协议消息之前允许的最大时间（毫秒）。

items.source: Set the time-to-live of the message when sending.
items.translation: 发送时设置消息的生存时间 (TTL)。

items.source: Specify the time unit for the delay and period values.
items.translation: 指定延迟和周期值的时间单位。

items.source: Set the user's time zone.
items.translation: 设置用户时区。

items.source: Specify the time zone for this trigger's cron expression.
items.translation: 指定此触发器的 cron 表达式的时间区域。

items.source:
